     1	# CI toolchain notes (mise + GitHub Actions)
     2	
     3	- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` uses `jdx/mise-action@v2` for both `python` and
     4	  `frontend` jobs. That action already runs `mise install` by default
     5	  (`install: true`) and already passes `github_token: ${{ github.token }}` by
     6	  default — do not add a separate explicit `mise install` step after it.
     7	- mise now verifies GitHub artifact attestations for precompiled Python builds
     8	  by default (`python.github_attestations`, defaults to the global
     9	  `github_attestations = true`). python-build-standalone only started
    10	  publishing attestations after it moved under the astral-sh org
    11	  (2024-12-17). Any pinned Python patch version built before that date
    12	  (e.g. 3.12.5, released Aug 2024) has no attestation and fails to install
    13	  with "No GitHub artifact attestations found for python@X.Y.Z" once mise
    14	  upgrades past the version that made verification default-on.
    15	- Fix: bump the pinned Python patch version in `mise.toml` to a newer 3.12.x
    16	  release (attestations exist for all recent python-build-standalone
    17	  releases) rather than disabling `python.github_attestations`/
    18	  `github_attestations`. Disabling attestation verification is a security
    19	  regression and should only be done with explicit justification.
    20	- mise CLI version itself isn't pinned in CI (mise-action@v2 installs
    21	  "latest" mise unless `version:` is set) — this is how new mise behavior
    22	  (like attestation verification) can show up unexpectedly in CI without any
    23	  repo config change.

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
from dataclasses import dataclass
from collections.abc import Mapping
from typing import cast
from uuid import UUID

from fpl_engine.planning.models import (
    Boundary,
    BoundaryOrigin,
    GameweekDecision,
    LineupRole,
    Ownership,
    Plan,
    PlanEvaluation,
    PurchaseProvenance,
    TransferDecision,
)
from fpl_engine.rules import Chip
from pydantic import TypeAdapter
from sqlalchemy import delete, null, select, update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from api.models import (
    PlanChip,
    PlanGameweekModel,
    PlanGameweekPlayerModel,
    PlanModel,
    PlayerModel,
    TeamModel,
)
from api.models.entities import (
    PlanMutationModel,
    PlanStartingPlayerModel,
    PlanTransferDecisionModel,
)

LINEUP_ADAPTER = TypeAdapter(tuple[LineupRole, ...])
PROVENANCE_ADAPTER = TypeAdapter(PurchaseProvenance)
TRANSFER_ADAPTER = TypeAdapter(TransferDecision)


class PlanNotReadyError(ValueError):
    def __init__(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"Plan {plan_id} requires explicit Planner initialization")
        self.plan_id = plan_id


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanPlayerRecord:
    player_id: int
    web_name: str
    first_name: str
    second_name: str
    team_id: int
    team_name: str
    team_short_name: str
    position: str
    current_price: float
    status: str
    is_starting: bool
    bench_order: int | None
    is_captain: bool
    is_vice_captain: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanGameweekRecord:
    gameweek_number: int
    chip: str | None
    bank: float
    free_transfers_available: int
    transfers_made: int
    points_hit: int
    players: list[PlanPlayerRecord]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanRecord:
    plan_id: int
    name: str
    start_gameweek: int
    end_gameweek: int
    initial_bank: float
    initial_free_transfers: int
    gameweeks: list[PlanGameweekRecord]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanSummaryRecord:
    plan_id: int
    name: str
    start_gameweek: int
    end_gameweek: int
    created_at: dt.datetime
    updated_at: dt.datetime


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanPlayerSave:
    player_id: int
    is_starting: bool
    bench_order: int | None
    is_captain: bool
    is_vice_captain: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanGameweekAccounting:
    gameweek_number: int
    bank: float
    free_transfers_available: int
    transfers_made: int
    points_hit: int


class PlanNotFoundError(LookupError):
    def __init__(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"Plan {plan_id} does not exist")
        self.plan_id = plan_id


class PlanRepository:
    def __init__(self, session: Session) -> None:
        self._session = session

    def lock_plan(self, plan_id: int, *, shared: bool = False) -> PlanModel:
        plan = self._session.scalar(
            select(PlanModel)
            .where(PlanModel.id == plan_id)
            .with_for_update(read=shared)
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
        )
        if plan is None:
            raise PlanNotFoundError(plan_id)
        return plan

    def load_canonical(self, plan_id: int) -> Plan:
        row = self.lock_plan(plan_id, shared=True)
        if (
            row.foundation_state != "ready"
            or row.boundary_lineup is None
            or (row.initial_bank_tenths is None)
        ):
            raise PlanNotReadyError(plan_id)
        starting = self._session.scalars(
            select(PlanStartingPlayerModel)
            .where(PlanStartingPlayerModel.plan_id == plan_id)
            .order_by(PlanStartingPlayerModel.id)
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
        ).all()
        boundary = Boundary(
            tuple(
                Ownership(
                    player.slot_id,
                    player.ownership_id,
                    player.player_id,
                    player.purchase_price_tenths,
                    PROVENANCE_ADAPTER.validate_python(player.provenance),
                )
                for player in starting
            ),
            LINEUP_ADAPTER.validate_python(row.boundary_lineup),
            row.initial_bank_tenths,
            row.starting_free_transfers,
            frozenset(Chip(chip) for chip in row.used_chips),
            row.free_hit_gameweek_19,
            TypeAdapter(BoundaryOrigin).validate_python(row.boundary_origin),
            frozenset(UUID(value) for value in row.bank_assumptions),
        )
        weeks = self._session.scalars(
            select(PlanGameweekModel)
            .where(PlanGameweekModel.plan_id == plan_id)
            .order_by(PlanGameweekModel.gameweek_number)
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
        ).all()
        decisions = self._session.scalars(
            select(PlanTransferDecisionModel)
            .join(PlanGameweekModel)
            .where(PlanGameweekModel.plan_id == plan_id)
            .order_by(PlanTransferDecisionModel.decision_id)
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
        ).all()
        transfers: dict[int, list[TransferDecision]] = {}
        for decision in decisions:
            transfers.setdefault(decision.plan_gameweek_id, []).append(
                TRANSFER_ADAPTER.validate_python(
                    {
                        field: getattr(decision, field)
                        for field in TransferDecision.__dataclass_fields__
                    }
                )
            )
        return Plan(
            row.name,
            row.start_gameweek,
            row.end_gameweek,
            boundary,
            tuple(
                GameweekDecision(
                    week.gameweek_number,
                    LINEUP_ADAPTER.validate_python(week.slot_lineup),
                    tuple(transfers.get(week.id, [])),
                    Chip(week.planned_chip) if week.planned_chip is not None else None,
                )
                for week in weeks
                if row.start_gameweek <= week.gameweek_number <= row.end_gameweek
            ),
            row.revision,
        )

    def save_canonical(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        plan: Plan,
        evaluation: PlanEvaluation,
        *,
        initial_sales: Mapping[UUID, int] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        row = self.lock_plan(plan_id)
        row.name, row.start_gameweek, row.end_gameweek = (
            plan.name,
            plan.start_gameweek,
            plan.end_gameweek,
        )
        row.revision = plan.revision
        row.initial_bank_tenths = plan.boundary.bank_tenths
        row.starting_free_transfers = plan.boundary.free_transfers
        row.boundary_origin = plan.boundary.origin
        row.boundary_lineup = cast(
            list[dict[str, object]], LINEUP_ADAPTER.dump_python(plan.boundary.lineup, mode="json")
        )
        row.used_chips = sorted(chip.value for chip in plan.boundary.used_chips)
        row.free_hit_gameweek_19 = plan.boundary.free_hit_gameweek_19
        row.bank_assumptions = sorted(str(value) for value in plan.boundary.bank_assumptions)
        if row.foundation_state != "ready":
            row.initialization_version = 1
            row.initialized_at = dt.datetime.now(dt.UTC)
        row.foundation_state = "ready"
        row.updated_at = dt.datetime.now(dt.UTC)
        existing = self._session.scalars(
            select(PlanStartingPlayerModel)
            .where(PlanStartingPlayerModel.plan_id == plan_id)
            .order_by(PlanStartingPlayerModel.id)
        ).all()
        previous = tuple(
            Ownership(
                player.slot_id,
                player.ownership_id,
                player.player_id,
                player.purchase_price_tenths,
                PROVENANCE_ADAPTER.validate_python(player.provenance),
            )
            for player in existing
        )
        if previous != plan.boundary.players:
            self._session.execute(
                delete(PlanStartingPlayerModel).where(PlanStartingPlayerModel.plan_id == plan_id)
            )
            self._session.flush()
            self._session.add_all(
                [
                    PlanStartingPlayerModel(
                        plan_id=plan_id,
                        player_id=player.player_id,
                        slot_id=player.slot_id,
                        ownership_id=player.ownership_id,
                        purchase_price_tenths=player.purchase_price_tenths,
                        provenance=cast(
                            dict[str, object],
                            PROVENANCE_ADAPTER.dump_python(player.provenance, mode="json"),
                        ),
                    )
                    for player in plan.boundary.players
                ]
            )
        retained = {week.gameweek_number for week in plan.gameweeks}
        weeks = {
            week.gameweek_number: week
            for week in self._session.scalars(
                select(PlanGameweekModel).where(PlanGameweekModel.plan_id == plan_id)
            )
        }
        for number, removed_week in weeks.items():
            if number not in retained:
                self._session.delete(removed_week)
        self._session.flush()
        sales = dict(initial_sales or {})
        sales.update(
            {
                sale.decision_id: sale.selling_price_tenths
                for week in evaluation.gameweeks
                for sale in week.sales
            }
        )
        for week in plan.gameweeks:
            stored = weeks.get(week.gameweek_number)
            if stored is None:
                stored = PlanGameweekModel(plan_id=plan_id, gameweek_number=week.gameweek_number)
                self._session.add(stored)
                self._session.flush()
            stored.planned_chip = week.chip.value if week.chip is not None else None
            stored.slot_lineup = cast(
                list[dict[str, object]], LINEUP_ADAPTER.dump_python(week.lineup, mode="json")
            )
            old = self._session.scalars(
                select(PlanTransferDecisionModel)
                .where(PlanTransferDecisionModel.plan_gameweek_id == stored.id)
                .order_by(PlanTransferDecisionModel.decision_id)
            ).all()
            old_inputs = tuple(
                TRANSFER_ADAPTER.validate_python(
                    {
                        field: getattr(decision, field)
                        for field in TransferDecision.__dataclass_fields__
                    }
                )
                for decision in old
            )
            if old_inputs == week.transfers:
                for decision in old:
                    if decision.decision_id in sales:
                        decision.selling_price_tenths = sales[decision.decision_id]
                continue
            self._session.execute(
                delete(PlanTransferDecisionModel).where(
                    PlanTransferDecisionModel.plan_gameweek_id == stored.id
                )
            )
            self._session.flush()
            previous_sales = {
                decision.decision_id: decision.selling_price_tenths for decision in old
            }
            for transfer in week.transfers:
                sale = sales.get(transfer.decision_id, previous_sales.get(transfer.decision_id))
                if sale is None:
                    raise ValueError("Cannot materialize an unevaluated new sale")
                self._session.add(
                    PlanTransferDecisionModel(
                        plan_gameweek_id=stored.id,
                        selling_price_tenths=sale,
                        **{
                            field: getattr(transfer, field)
                            for field in TransferDecision.__dataclass_fields__
                        },
                    )
                )
        self._session.flush()

    def get_receipt(self, plan_id: int, mutation_id: UUID) -> PlanMutationModel | None:
        return self._session.scalar(
            select(PlanMutationModel)
            .where(
                PlanMutationModel.plan_id == plan_id, PlanMutationModel.mutation_id == mutation_id
            )
            .execution_options(populate_existing=True)
        )

    def accept_mutation(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        mutation_id: UUID,
        *,
        digest: str,
        expected_revision: int,
        evaluator_version: str,
        rule_fingerprint: str,
        pending_inputs: dict[str, object],
    ) -> PlanMutationModel:
        self.lock_plan(plan_id)
        receipt = PlanMutationModel(
            plan_id=plan_id,
            mutation_id=mutation_id,
            digest=digest,
            expected_revision=expected_revision,
            status="validated_pending",
            evaluator_version=evaluator_version,
            rule_fingerprint=rule_fingerprint,
            pending_inputs=pending_inputs,
        )
        self._session.add(receipt)
        self._session.flush()
        return receipt

    def commit_mutation(self, receipt: PlanMutationModel, revision: int) -> None:
        self._session.execute(
            update(PlanMutationModel)
            .where(PlanMutationModel.id == receipt.id)
            .values(status="committed", pending_inputs=null(), committed_revision=revision)
            .execution_options(synchronize_session=False)
        )
        self._session.expire(receipt)
        self._session.flush()

    def list_plans(self) -> list[PlanSummaryRecord]:
        plans = self._session.execute(
            select(PlanModel).order_by(PlanModel.updated_at.desc())
        ).scalars()
        return [
            PlanSummaryRecord(
                plan_id=plan.id,
                name=plan.name,
                start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
                end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
                created_at=plan.created_at,
                updated_at=plan.updated_at,
            )
            for plan in plans
        ]

    def get(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        plan = self._session.get(PlanModel, plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return None

        gameweeks = list(
            self._session.execute(
                select(PlanGameweekModel)
                .where(PlanGameweekModel.plan_id == plan_id)
                .order_by(PlanGameweekModel.gameweek_number.asc())
            ).scalars()
        )
        players_by_gameweek = self._load_players({row.id: row for row in gameweeks})

        return PlanRecord(
            plan_id=plan.id,
            name=plan.name,
            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=float(plan.initial_bank),
            initial_free_transfers=plan.initial_free_transfers,
            gameweeks=[
                PlanGameweekRecord(
                    gameweek_number=gameweek.gameweek_number,
                    chip=gameweek.chip.value if gameweek.chip is not None else None,
                    bank=float(gameweek.bank),
                    free_transfers_available=gameweek.free_transfers_available,
                    transfers_made=gameweek.transfers_made,
                    points_hit=gameweek.points_hit,
                    players=players_by_gameweek.get(gameweek.id, []),
                )
                for gameweek in gameweeks
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan = PlanModel(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        self._session.add(plan)
        self._session.flush()
        return plan.id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._require(plan_id)
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek
        plan.updated_at = dt.datetime.now(dt.UTC)
        self._session.flush()

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        plan = self._require(plan_id)
        self._session.delete(plan)
        self._session.flush()

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        self._session.execute(
            delete(PlanGameweekModel).where(
                PlanGameweekModel.plan_id == plan_id,
                (PlanGameweekModel.gameweek_number < start)
                | (PlanGameweekModel.gameweek_number > end),
            )
        )
        self._session.flush()

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._require(plan_id)
        gameweek = self._session.execute(
            select(PlanGameweekModel).where(
                PlanGameweekModel.plan_id == plan_id,
                PlanGameweekModel.gameweek_number == gameweek_number,
            )
        ).scalar_one_or_none()

        if gameweek is None:
            gameweek = PlanGameweekModel(plan_id=plan_id, gameweek_number=gameweek_number)
            self._session.add(gameweek)

        gameweek.chip = PlanChip(chip) if chip is not None else None
        gameweek.bank = bank
        gameweek.free_transfers_available = free_transfers_available
        gameweek.transfers_made = transfers_made
        gameweek.points_hit = points_hit
        self._session.flush()

        self._session.execute(
            delete(PlanGameweekPlayerModel).where(
                PlanGameweekPlayerModel.plan_gameweek_id == gameweek.id
            )
        )
        self._session.add_all(
            [
                PlanGameweekPlayerModel(
                    plan_gameweek_id=gameweek.id,
                    player_id=player.player_id,
                    is_starting=player.is_starting,
                    bench_order=player.bench_order,
                    is_captain=player.is_captain,
                    is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                )
                for player in players
            ]
        )
        plan.updated_at = dt.datetime.now(dt.UTC)
        self._session.flush()

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        if not entries:
            return

        by_number = {entry.gameweek_number: entry for entry in entries}
        gameweeks = self._session.execute(
            select(PlanGameweekModel).where(
                PlanGameweekModel.plan_id == plan_id,
                PlanGameweekModel.gameweek_number.in_(by_number.keys()),
            )
        ).scalars()

        for gameweek in gameweeks:
            entry = by_number[gameweek.gameweek_number]
            gameweek.bank = entry.bank
            gameweek.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            gameweek.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            gameweek.points_hit = entry.points_hit
        self._session.flush()

    def _require(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanModel:
        plan = self._session.get(PlanModel, plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            raise PlanNotFoundError(plan_id)
        return plan

    def _load_players(
        self, gameweeks_by_id: dict[int, PlanGameweekModel]
    ) -> dict[int, list[PlanPlayerRecord]]:
        if not gameweeks_by_id:
            return {}

        rows = self._session.execute(
            select(
                PlanGameweekPlayerModel.plan_gameweek_id,
                PlayerModel.id,
                PlayerModel.web_name,
                PlayerModel.first_name,
                PlayerModel.second_name,
                TeamModel.id,
                TeamModel.name,
                TeamModel.short_name,
                PlayerModel.position,
                PlayerModel.current_price,
                PlayerModel.status,
                PlanGameweekPlayerModel.is_starting,
                PlanGameweekPlayerModel.bench_order,
                PlanGameweekPlayerModel.is_captain,
                PlanGameweekPlayerModel.is_vice_captain,
            )
            .join(PlayerModel, PlayerModel.id == PlanGameweekPlayerModel.player_id)
            .join(TeamModel, TeamModel.id == PlayerModel.team_id)
            .where(PlanGameweekPlayerModel.plan_gameweek_id.in_(gameweeks_by_id.keys()))
            .order_by(
                PlanGameweekPlayerModel.is_starting.desc(),
                PlanGameweekPlayerModel.bench_order.asc().nulls_last(),
                PlayerModel.web_name.asc(),
            )
        ).all()

        players_by_gameweek: dict[int, list[PlanPlayerRecord]] = {}
        for row in rows:
            players_by_gameweek.setdefault(row[0], []).append(
                PlanPlayerRecord(
                    player_id=row[1],
                    web_name=row[2],
                    first_name=row[3],
                    second_name=row[4],
                    team_id=row[5],
                    team_name=row[6],
                    team_short_name=row[7],
                    position=row[8].value if hasattr(row[8], "value") else str(row[8]),
                    current_price=float(row[9]),
                    status=row[10],
                    is_starting=row[11],
                    bench_order=row[12],
                    is_captain=row[13],
                    is_vice_captain=row[14],
                )
            )
        return players_by_gameweek

from __future__ import annotations

from uuid import UUID

import pytest
from api.models.entities import PlanGameweekModel, PlanModel
from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
from conftest import requires_database, seed_planner_players as seed_players
from fpl_engine.planning.evaluate import evaluate_plan
from fpl_engine.planning.models import Plan, PlayerRuleData
from sqlalchemy import delete, select
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

pytestmark = requires_database


def new_plan(session: Session) -> PlanModel:
    plan = PlanModel(name="SQL plan", start_gameweek=8, end_gameweek=9)
    session.add(plan)
    session.flush()
    return plan


def test_receipt_identity_constraints_and_plan_delete_cascade(planner_session: Session) -> None:
    from api.models.entities import PlanMutationModel

    plan = new_plan(planner_session)
    mutation_id = UUID(int=1)
    receipt = PlanMutationModel(
        plan_id=plan.id,
        mutation_id=mutation_id,
        digest="a" * 64,
        expected_revision=0,
        status="validated_pending",
        evaluator_version="test",
        rule_fingerprint="b" * 64,
        pending_inputs={"intents": []},
    )
    planner_session.add(receipt)
    planner_session.flush()
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError), planner_session.begin_nested():
        planner_session.add(
            PlanMutationModel(
                plan_id=plan.id,
                mutation_id=mutation_id,
                digest="c" * 64,
                expected_revision=0,
                status="validated_pending",
                evaluator_version="test",
                rule_fingerprint="b" * 64,
                pending_inputs={"intents": []},
            )
        )
        planner_session.flush()
    planner_session.execute(delete(PlanModel).where(PlanModel.id == plan.id))
    assert planner_session.scalars(select(PlanMutationModel)).all() == []


def test_nullable_canonical_chip_is_independent_of_legacy_chip(planner_session: Session) -> None:
    from api.models.entities import PlanChip

    plan = new_plan(planner_session)
    week = PlanGameweekModel(
        plan_id=plan.id, gameweek_number=8, chip=PlanChip.WILDCARD, planned_chip=None
    )
    planner_session.add(week)
    planner_session.flush()
    planner_session.expire_all()
    stored = planner_session.get(PlanGameweekModel, week.id)
    assert stored.planned_chip is None
    assert stored.chip == PlanChip.WILDCARD


@pytest.mark.parametrize("revision", [-1])
def test_revision_cannot_be_negative(planner_session: Session, revision: int) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError), planner_session.begin_nested():
        planner_session.add(
            PlanModel(name="Invalid", start_gameweek=8, end_gameweek=9, revision=revision)
        )
        planner_session.flush()


def test_canonical_load_and_rollback_are_independent_of_legacy_fields(
    planner_session: Session, planner_plan: Plan, planner_metadata: dict[int, PlayerRuleData]
) -> None:
    from dataclasses import replace

    seed_players(planner_session, planner_metadata)
    stored = new_plan(planner_session)
    plan_id = stored.id
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    repository.save_canonical(plan_id, planner_plan, evaluate_plan(planner_plan, planner_metadata))
    planner_session.commit()
    loaded = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
    assert loaded == planner_plan
    assert stored.initial_bank == 0.0
    assert stored.initial_free_transfers == 1
    repository.save_canonical(
        plan_id,
        replace(planner_plan, name="Uncommitted", revision=1),
        evaluate_plan(planner_plan, planner_metadata),
    )
    planner_session.rollback()
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id) == planner_plan


def test_pending_receipt_contains_only_inputs_and_commit_drops_redundant_payload(
    planner_session: Session,
) -> None:
    from api.models.entities import PlanMutationModel

    plan = new_plan(planner_session)
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    receipt = repository.accept_mutation(
        plan.id,
        UUID(int=7),
        digest="a" * 64,
        expected_revision=0,
        evaluator_version="test",
        rule_fingerprint="b" * 64,
        pending_inputs={"intents": [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Renamed"}]},
    )
    planner_session.commit()
    assert repository.get_receipt(plan.id, UUID(int=7)).pending_inputs == {
        "intents": [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Renamed"}]
    }
    repository.commit_mutation(receipt, 1)
    planner_session.commit()
    stored = planner_session.get(PlanMutationModel, receipt.id)
    assert stored.pending_inputs is None
    assert stored.committed_revision == 1
    assert stored.digest == "a" * 64

@pytest.fixture
def guarded_mutations(planner_session, planner_plan, planner_metadata):
    from api.models.entities import PlanModel
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from api.repositories.squad_player_lookup_repository import SquadPlayerLookupRepository
    from api.services.plans import PlanMutationService
    from conftest import seed_planner_players
    from fpl_engine.planning.evaluate import evaluate_plan

    seed_planner_players(planner_session, planner_metadata)
    row = PlanModel(name=planner_plan.name, start_gameweek=8, end_gameweek=10)
    planner_session.add(row)
    planner_session.flush()
    plan_id = row.id
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    repository.save_canonical(plan_id, planner_plan, evaluate_plan(planner_plan, planner_metadata))
    planner_session.commit()
    return PlanMutationService(planner_session, SquadPlayerLookupRepository(planner_session)), plan_id


def mutation_body(number=1, revision=0, intents=None):
    import json
    from uuid import UUID
    from api.schemas.plans import PlanMutationRequestBody

    return PlanMutationRequestBody.model_validate_json(json.dumps({
        "mutation_id": str(UUID(int=number)), "expected_revision": revision,
        "intents": intents or [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Renamed"}],
    }))


@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_guarded_rename_is_idempotent_even_after_a_later_revision(guarded_mutations):
    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    first = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    assert (first.status, first.committed_revision, first.plan.name) == ("committed", 1, "Renamed")
    service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(2, 1, [{"kind": "set_starting_transfers", "value": 3}]))
    retry = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    assert retry.status == "already_committed"
    assert retry.committed_revision == 1
    assert retry.plan.revision == 2
    assert retry.plan.boundary.free_transfers == 3


@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_guarded_stale_rename_and_changed_digest_never_write(guarded_mutations):
    from api.services.plans import PlannerMutationError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as stale:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(2))
    assert stale.value.code == "revision_conflict"
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as changed:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(1, 0, [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Changed"}]))
    assert changed.value.code == "mutation_id_reused"


@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_guarded_failure_after_acceptance_keeps_same_id_retryable(guarded_mutations, monkeypatch):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from api.services.plans import PlannerMutationError
    from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    original = PlanRepository.save_canonical
    def fail_write(*args, **kwargs):
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected canonical write failure")
    monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "save_canonical", fail_write)
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as failed:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    assert failed.value.code == "accepted_not_saved"
    pending = service.lookup(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id)
    assert pending.status == "accepted_not_saved"
    assert pending.candidate.name == "Renamed"
    assert pending.plan.revision == 0
    monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "save_canonical", original)
    assert service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body()).committed_revision == 1

class FakePlanRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._plans: dict[int, _StoredPlan] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    def list_plans(self) -> list[PlanSummaryRecord]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def get(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        plan = self._plans.get(plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return None
        return PlanRecord(
            plan_id=plan_id,
            name=plan.name,
            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=plan.initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=plan.initial_free_transfers,
            gameweeks=[
                PlanGameweekRecord(
                    gameweek_number=number,
                    chip=stored.chip,
                    bank=stored.bank,
                    free_transfers_available=stored.free_transfers_available,
                    transfers_made=stored.transfers_made,
                    points_hit=stored.points_hit,
                    players=[
                        PlanPlayerRecord(
                            player_id=player.player_id,
                            web_name=f"P{player.player_id}",
                            first_name="First",
                            second_name="Second",
                            team_id=player.player_id,
                            team_name=f"Team {player.player_id}",
                            team_short_name="TMX",
                            position=POSITIONS[player.player_id],
                            current_price=PRICES[player.player_id],
                            status="a",
                            is_starting=player.is_starting,
                            bench_order=player.bench_order,
                            is_captain=player.is_captain,
                            is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                        )
                        for player in stored.players
                    ],
                )
                for number, stored in sorted(plan.gameweeks.items())
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._plans[plan_id] = _StoredPlan(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        return plan_id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        del self._plans[plan_id]

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        plan.gameweeks = {
            number: stored for number, stored in plan.gameweeks.items() if start <= number <= end
        }

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        self._plans[plan_id].gameweeks[gameweek_number] = _StoredGameweek(
            chip=chip,
            bank=bank,
            free_transfers_available=free_transfers_available,
            transfers_made=transfers_made,
            points_hit=points_hit,
            players=list(players),
        )

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        for entry in entries:
            stored = plan.gameweeks[entry.gameweek_number]
            stored.bank = entry.bank
            stored.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            stored.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            stored.points_hit = entry.points_hit

class TestCreatePlan:
    def test_seeds_every_gameweek_in_the_horizon(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        plan = repository.get(plan_id)
        assert plan is not None
        assert [gameweek.gameweek_number for gameweek in plan.gameweeks] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
        assert all(len(gameweek.players) == 15 for gameweek in plan.gameweeks)

    def test_rejects_blank_name(self, repository: FakePlanRepository) -> None:
        service = CreatePlanService(repository, FakeCurrentSquadRepository())
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            service.execute(CreatePlanRequest(name="  ", start_gameweek=1, end_gameweek=4))
        assert error.value.code == "plan_name"

    def test_rejects_backwards_horizon(self, repository: FakePlanRepository) -> None:
        service = CreatePlanService(repository, FakeCurrentSquadRepository())
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            service.execute(CreatePlanRequest(name="Plan", start_gameweek=6, end_gameweek=3))
        assert error.value.code == "plan_horizon"

    def test_requires_a_saved_squad(self, repository: FakePlanRepository) -> None:
        service = CreatePlanService(repository, FakeCurrentSquadRepository(players=[]))
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            service.execute(CreatePlanRequest(name="Plan", start_gameweek=1, end_gameweek=4))
        assert error.value.code == "no_squad"


class TestUpdatePlan:

class TestSavePlanGameweek:
    def test_bench_and_starters_can_be_reshuffled_for_free(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        swapped = [
            player
            if player.player_id not in (14, 15)
            else PlanPlayerSelection(
                player_id=player.player_id,
                is_starting=player.player_id == 15,
                bench_order=4 if player.player_id == 14 else None,
                is_captain=player.is_captain,
                is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
            )
            for player in squad
        ]

        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, swapped)

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 0
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 0

    def test_transfer_consumes_a_free_transfer_and_carries_forward(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=17))

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 1
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 0
        assert all(
            17 in {player.player_id for player in gameweek.players}
            for gameweek in plan.gameweeks[1:]
        )

    def test_extra_transfers_in_one_gameweek_cost_four_points(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        squad = transfer(
            transfer(transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=17), out_id=11, in_id=16),
            out_id=10,
            in_id=20,
        )

        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, squad)

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 3
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 8

    def test_wildcard_removes_the_hit(self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int) -> None:
        squad = transfer(
            transfer(transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=17), out_id=11, in_id=16),
            out_id=10,
            in_id=20,
        )

        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, squad, chip="WILDCARD")

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 0
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].chip == "WILDCARD"

    def test_same_chip_cannot_be_used_twice_in_one_half(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        _save(repository, plan_id, 2, build_squad(), chip="BENCH_BOOST")

        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            _save(repository, plan_id, 3, build_squad(), chip="BENCH_BOOST")
        assert error.value.code == "chip_already_used"

    def test_transfer_that_breaks_the_budget_is_rejected(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            _save(repository, plan_id, 2, transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=21))
        assert error.value.code == "budget"

    def test_illegal_formation_is_rejected(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        squad = [
            player
            if player.player_id not in (1, 2)
            else PlanPlayerSelection(
                player_id=player.player_id,
                is_starting=True,
                bench_order=None,
                is_captain=False,
                is_vice_captain=False,
            )
            for player in build_squad()
        ]

        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
            _save(repository, plan_id, 2, squad)

    def test_gameweek_outside_the_plan_is_rejected(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            _save(repository, plan_id, 9, build_squad())
        assert error.value.code == "gameweek_outside_plan"

    def test_unknown_plan_raises(self, repository: FakePlanRepository) -> None:

            _save(repository, 99, 1, build_squad())

def mutation_body(number=1, revision=0, intents=None):
    import json
    from uuid import UUID

    from api.schemas.plans import PlanMutationRequestBody

    return PlanMutationRequestBody.model_validate_json(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "mutation_id": str(UUID(int=number)),
                "expected_revision": revision,
                "intents": intents or [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Renamed"}],
            }
        )
    )


@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_legacy_initialization_is_once_only_and_preserves_original_rows(
    planner_session, planner_plan, planner_metadata,
):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository, PlanPlayerSave
    from api.repositories.squad_player_lookup_repository import SquadPlayerLookupRepository
    from api.services.initialize_planner_foundations import InitializePlannerFoundationsService
    from conftest import seed_planner_players

    seed_planner_players(planner_session, planner_metadata)
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    plan_id = repository.create(name="Legacy", start_gameweek=8, end_gameweek=10,
                                 initial_bank=0.7, initial_free_transfers=4)
    for week in planner_plan.gameweeks:
        repository.save_gameweek(plan_id, week.gameweek_number, chip=None, bank=0.7,
            free_transfers_available=4, transfers_made=0, points_hit=0, players=[
                PlanPlayerSave(player.player_id, role.is_starting, role.bench_order,
                               role.is_captain, role.is_vice_captain)
                for player, role in zip(planner_plan.boundary.players, week.lineup, strict=True)
            ])
    planner_session.commit()
    before = repository.get(plan_id)
    service = InitializePlannerFoundationsService(planner_session,
                                                 SquadPlayerLookupRepository(planner_session))
    assert service.execute(plan_id, apply=False).status == "ready_to_initialize"
    assert service.execute(plan_id, apply=True).status == "initialized"
    after = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
    assert after.boundary.free_transfers == 4
    assert after.boundary.bank_tenths == 7
    assert after.boundary.origin == "legacy_first_gameweek_assumed"
    assert not after.boundary.used_chips
    assert repository.get(plan_id) == before
    planner_session.commit()
    assert service.execute(plan_id, apply=True).status == "already_ready"
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id) == after


@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_guarded_rename_is_idempotent_even_after_a_later_revision(guarded_mutations):
    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    first = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    assert (first.status, first.committed_revision, first.plan.name) == ("committed", 1, "Renamed")
    service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(2, 1, [{"kind": "set_starting_transfers", "value": 3}]))
    retry = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    assert retry.status == "already_committed"
    assert retry.committed_revision == 1
    assert retry.plan.revision == 2
    assert retry.plan.boundary.free_transfers == 3


@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_guarded_stale_rename_and_changed_digest_never_write(guarded_mutations):
    from api.services.plans import PlannerMutationError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as stale:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(2))
    assert stale.value.code == "revision_conflict"
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as changed:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(1, 0, [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Changed"}]))
    assert changed.value.code == "mutation_id_reused"


@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_guarded_failure_after_acceptance_keeps_same_id_retryable(guarded_mutations, monkeypatch):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from api.services.plans import PlannerMutationError
    from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    original = PlanRepository.save_canonical

    def fail_write(*args, **kwargs):
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected canonical write failure")

    monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "save_canonical", fail_write)
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as failed:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    assert failed.value.code == "accepted_not_saved"
    pending = service.lookup(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id)
    assert pending.status == "accepted_not_saved"
    assert pending.candidate.name == "Renamed"
    assert pending.plan.revision == 0
    monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "save_canonical", original)
    assert service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body()).committed_revision == 1

class FakePlanRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._plans: dict[int, _StoredPlan] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    def list_plans(self) -> list[PlanSummaryRecord]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def get(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        plan = self._plans.get(plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return None
        return PlanRecord(
            plan_id=plan_id,
            name=plan.name,
            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=plan.initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=plan.initial_free_transfers,
            gameweeks=[
                PlanGameweekRecord(
                    gameweek_number=number,
                    chip=stored.chip,
                    bank=stored.bank,
                    free_transfers_available=stored.free_transfers_available,
                    transfers_made=stored.transfers_made,
                    points_hit=stored.points_hit,
                    players=[
                        PlanPlayerRecord(
                            player_id=player.player_id,
                            web_name=f"P{player.player_id}",
                            first_name="First",
                            second_name="Second",
                            team_id=player.player_id,
                            team_name=f"Team {player.player_id}",
                            team_short_name="TMX",
                            position=POSITIONS[player.player_id],
                            current_price=PRICES[player.player_id],
                            status="a",
                            is_starting=player.is_starting,
                            bench_order=player.bench_order,
                            is_captain=player.is_captain,
                            is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                        )
                        for player in stored.players
                    ],
                )
                for number, stored in sorted(plan.gameweeks.items())
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._plans[plan_id] = _StoredPlan(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        return plan_id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        del self._plans[plan_id]

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        plan.gameweeks = {
            number: stored for number, stored in plan.gameweeks.items() if start <= number <= end
        }

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        self._plans[plan_id].gameweeks[gameweek_number] = _StoredGameweek(
            chip=chip,
            bank=bank,
            free_transfers_available=free_transfers_available,
            transfers_made=transfers_made,
            points_hit=points_hit,
            players=list(players),
        )

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        for entry in entries:
            stored = plan.gameweeks[entry.gameweek_number]
            stored.bank = entry.bank
            stored.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            stored.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            stored.points_hit = entry.points_hit

    mode.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

class FakePlanRepository:

    def list_plans(self) -> list[PlanSummaryRecord]:

            name=plan.name,
            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,

                    transfers_made=stored.transfers_made,

                    players=[
                        PlanPlayerRecord(
                            player_id=player.player_id,
                            web_name=f"P{player.player_id}",
                            first_name="First",
                            second_name="Second",
                            team_id=player.player_id,
                            team_name=f"Team {player.player_id}",
                            team_short_name="TMX",
                            position=POSITIONS[player.player_id],
                            current_price=PRICES[player.player_id],
                            status="a",
                            is_starting=player.is_starting,
                            bench_order=player.bench_order,
                            is_captain=player.is_captain,
                            is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                        )
                        for player in stored.players
                    ],
                )
                for number, stored in sorted(plan.gameweeks.items())
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._plans[plan_id] = _StoredPlan(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        return plan_id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        del self._plans[plan_id]

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        plan.gameweeks = {
            number: stored for number, stored in plan.gameweeks.items() if start <= number <= end
        }

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        self._plans[plan_id].gameweeks[gameweek_number] = _StoredGameweek(
            chip=chip,
            bank=bank,
            free_transfers_available=free_transfers_available,
            transfers_made=transfers_made,
            points_hit=points_hit,
            players=list(players),
        )

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        for entry in entries:
            stored = plan.gameweeks[entry.gameweek_number]
            stored.bank = entry.bank
            stored.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            stored.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            stored.points_hit = entry.points_hit

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from alembic.migration import MigrationContext
from alembic.operations import Operations
from conftest import requires_database
from sqlalchemy import func, select, text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

pytestmark = requires_database


def migration_module():
    path = Path(__file__).parents[2] / "alembic/versions/c6f91a2d83b0_add_planner_foundations.py"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("planner_migration", path)
    assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def test_isolated_upgrade_downgrade_reupgrade_preserves_legacy_values(planner_session: Session) -> None:
    engine = planner_session.get_bind()
    schema = engine.get_execution_options()["schema_translate_map"][None]
    migration = migration_module()
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        connection.execute(select(func.set_config("search_path", schema, True)))
        with Operations.context(MigrationContext.configure(connection)):
            migration.downgrade()
            connection.execute(text(
                "INSERT INTO plans (id, name, start_gameweek, end_gameweek, initial_bank, "
                "initial_free_transfers, created_at, updated_at) "
                "VALUES (1, 'Original', 8, 9, 0.7, 4, now(), now())"
            ))
            before = connection.execute(text("SELECT * FROM plans WHERE id=1")).mappings().one()
            migration.upgrade()
            assert connection.execute(text("SELECT foundation_state FROM plans WHERE id=1")).scalar_one() == "legacy_pending"
            migration.downgrade()
            after = connection.execute(text("SELECT * FROM plans WHERE id=1")).mappings().one()
            assert dict(after) == dict(before)
            migration.upgrade()
            assert connection.execute(text("SELECT revision FROM plans WHERE id=1")).scalar_one() == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("new_write", ["revision", "new_plan"])
def test_downgrade_refuses_loss_of_new_only_data(planner_session: Session, new_write: str) -> None:
    engine = planner_session.get_bind()
    schema = engine.get_execution_options()["schema_translate_map"][None]
    with engine.begin() as connection:
        connection.execute(select(func.set_config("search_path", schema, True)))
        connection.execute(text(
            "INSERT INTO plans (id, name, start_gameweek, end_gameweek, initial_bank, "
            "initial_free_transfers, created_at, updated_at, revision, foundation_state, boundary_origin) "
            "VALUES (1, 'New', 8, 9, 0, 1, now(), now(), :revision, 'ready', :origin)"
        ), {"revision": 1 if new_write == "revision" else 0,
            "origin": "legacy_first_gameweek_assumed" if new_write == "revision" else "my_team_capture"})
        with Operations.context(MigrationContext.configure(connection)):
            with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="Back up/export"):
                migration_module().downgrade()
        assert connection.execute(text("SELECT name FROM plans WHERE id=1")).scalar_one() == "New"

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
from uuid import UUID

import pytest
from fpl_engine.domain import PlayerPosition
from fpl_engine.planning.models import (
    Boundary,
    GameweekDecision,
    Plan,
    PlayerRuleData,
    TransferDecision,
)
from fpl_engine.rules import RuleViolationError, SquadSlot, validate_squad

POSITIONS = (
    PlayerPosition.GOALKEEPER,
    *([PlayerPosition.DEFENDER] * 4),
    *([PlayerPosition.MIDFIELDER] * 4),
    *([PlayerPosition.FORWARD] * 2),
    PlayerPosition.GOALKEEPER,
    PlayerPosition.DEFENDER,
    PlayerPosition.MIDFIELDER,
    PlayerPosition.FORWARD,
)


def identity(number: int) -> UUID:
    return UUID(int=number)


def build_players() -> dict[int, SquadSlot]:
    players = {
        index + 1: SquadSlot(
            player_id=index + 1,
            position=position,
            team_id=index % 5 + 1,
            is_starting=index < 11,
            bench_order=None if index < 11 else index - 10,
            is_captain=index == 1,
            is_vice_captain=index == 2,
        )
        for index, position in enumerate(POSITIONS)
    }
    return players | {
        player_id + 100: replace(player, player_id=player_id + 100, team_id=20 + player_id)
        for player_id, player in players.items()
    }


def test_fixture_is_a_legal_multi_club_squad() -> None:
    players = build_players()
    validate_squad(list(players.values())[:15])
    assert len({player.team_id for player in list(players.values())[:15]}) == 5
    assert players[102].position == players[2].position
    assert identity(1) == UUID("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001")


def build_boundary() -> Boundary:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import Boundary, LineupRole, Ownership, PurchaseProvenance

    players = tuple(
        Ownership(
            slot_id=identity(player_id),
            ownership_id=identity(1000 + player_id),
            player_id=player_id,
            purchase_price_tenths=50,
            provenance=PurchaseProvenance("stored_player_observation", 50),
        )
        for player_id in range(1, 16)
    )
    lineup = tuple(
        LineupRole(
            identity(player.player_id),
            player.is_starting,
            player.bench_order,
            player.is_captain,
            player.is_vice_captain,
        )
        for player in list(build_players().values())[:15]
    )
    return Boundary(players, lineup, 10, 1)


def build_transfer(outgoing: int = 2, incoming: int = 102, number: int = 1) -> TransferDecision:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import TransferDecision

    return TransferDecision(
        identity(2000 + number),
        outgoing,
        identity(1000 + outgoing),
        incoming,
        identity(3000 + number),
        54,
        50,
        "stored_player_observation",
        "2026-10-14T12:00:00+00:00",
        "captured",
    )


def test_boundary_contract_has_independent_stable_slots() -> None:
    boundary = build_boundary()
    assert len(boundary.players) == 15
    assert len({player.slot_id for player in boundary.players}) == 15
    assert boundary.players[0].provenance.confirmation == "assumed"
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError, match="15"):
        replace(boundary, players=boundary.players[:14])
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        replace(boundary, players=(boundary.players[0],) + boundary.players[:-1])
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        replace(boundary.players[0], slot_id="invalid")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("price", [0, -1, 5.5, True])
def test_price_inputs_must_be_positive_whole_tenths(price: object) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        replace(build_boundary().players[0], purchase_price_tenths=price)


def test_net_set_rejects_duplicate_changes_and_round_trips() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import GameweekDecision

    boundary = build_boundary()
    transfer = build_transfer()
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        GameweekDecision(8, boundary.lineup, (transfer, transfer))
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        GameweekDecision(8, boundary.lineup, (transfer, build_transfer(102, 2, 2)))


def test_planned_acquisition_provenance_is_not_an_estimated_historical_purchase() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import PurchaseProvenance

    provenance = PurchaseProvenance("decision:example", 52, "planned_acquisition", None)
    assert provenance.confirmation is None
    assert provenance.original_price_tenths == 52
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        replace(provenance, confirmation="assumed")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("market", "sale"), [(48, 48), (50, 50), (51, 50), (52, 51), (53, 51), (54, 52)]
)
def test_official_sale_steps(market: int, sale: int) -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.prices import selling_price_tenths

    assert selling_price_tenths(50, market) == sale


def build_plan(start: int = 8, end: int = 11) -> Plan:
    boundary = build_boundary()
    return Plan(
        "Test plan",
        start,
        end,
        boundary,
        tuple(GameweekDecision(number, boundary.lineup) for number in range(start, end + 1)),
    )


def metadata() -> dict[int, PlayerRuleData]:
    return {
        player_id: PlayerRuleData(player_id, player.position, player.team_id)
        for player_id, player in build_players().items()
    }


def with_week(plan: Plan, number: int, **changes) -> Plan:
    return replace(
        plan,
        gameweeks=tuple(
            replace(week, **changes) if week.gameweek_number == number else week
            for week in plan.gameweeks
        ),
    )


def test_first_gameweek_counts_against_independent_boundary_with_zero_ft() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.evaluate import evaluate_plan

    plan = build_plan()
    plan = replace(plan, boundary=replace(plan.boundary, free_transfers=0))
    plan = with_week(plan, 8, transfers=(build_transfer(),))
    result = evaluate_plan(plan, metadata())
    assert not result.diagnostics
    week = result.gameweeks[0]
    assert (week.transfers_made, week.points_hit, week.next_free_transfers) == (1, 4, 1)
    assert week.closing_bank_tenths == 12
    assert week.sales[0].selling_price_tenths == 52


def test_example_a_free_hit_restores_permanent_ownership_without_phantom_transfers() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.evaluate import evaluate_plan
    from fpl_engine.rules import Chip

    plan = with_week(build_plan(), 8, transfers=(build_transfer(),))
    ordinary = evaluate_plan(plan, metadata())
    temporary = evaluate_plan(with_week(plan, 8, chip=Chip.FREE_HIT), metadata())
    assert not temporary.diagnostics
    assert ordinary.gameweeks[1].players[1].player_id == 102
    assert temporary.gameweeks[0].players[1].player_id == 102
    assert temporary.gameweeks[1].players == plan.boundary.players
    assert temporary.gameweeks[1].closing_bank_tenths == 10
    assert temporary.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 0
    assert temporary.gameweeks[1].lineup == plan.gameweeks[1].lineup


def test_example_b_missing_ownership_blocks_accounting_instead_of_retargeting() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.evaluate import evaluate_plan

    first = build_transfer()
    later = replace(build_transfer(102, 2, 2), outgoing_ownership_id=first.incoming_ownership_id)
    plan = with_week(with_week(build_plan(), 8, transfers=(first,)), 10, transfers=(later,))
    assert not evaluate_plan(plan, metadata()).diagnostics
    changed = with_week(plan, 8, transfers=(replace(first, incoming_player_id=103),))
    result = evaluate_plan(changed, metadata())
    assert any(
        error.code == "outgoing_not_owned" and error.decision_id == later.decision_id
        for error in result.diagnostics
    )
    assert result.gameweeks[2].closing_bank_tenths is None
    assert result.gameweeks[3].transfers_made is None
    assert result.gameweeks[3].shortfall_tenths is None

from __future__ import annotations

import datetime as dt
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import cast
from uuid import UUID

from fpl_engine.planning.models import (
    Boundary,
    BoundaryOrigin,
    GameweekDecision,
    LineupRole,
    Ownership,
    Plan,
    PlanEvaluation,
    PurchaseProvenance,
    TransferDecision,
)
from fpl_engine.rules import Chip
from pydantic import TypeAdapter
from sqlalchemy import delete, null, select, update
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

from api.models import (
    PlanChip,
    PlanGameweekModel,
    PlanGameweekPlayerModel,
    PlanModel,
    PlayerModel,
    TeamModel,
)
from api.models.entities import (
    PlanMutationModel,
    PlanStartingPlayerModel,
    PlanTransferDecisionModel,
)

LINEUP_ADAPTER = TypeAdapter(tuple[LineupRole, ...])
PROVENANCE_ADAPTER = TypeAdapter(PurchaseProvenance)
TRANSFER_ADAPTER = TypeAdapter(TransferDecision)


class PlanNotReadyError(ValueError):
    def __init__(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"Plan {plan_id} requires explicit Planner initialization")
        self.plan_id = plan_id


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanPlayerRecord:
    player_id: int
    web_name: str
    first_name: str
    second_name: str
    team_id: int
    team_name: str
    team_short_name: str
    position: str
    current_price: float
    status: str
    is_starting: bool
    bench_order: int | None
    is_captain: bool
    is_vice_captain: bool


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanGameweekRecord:
    gameweek_number: int
    chip: str | None
    bank: float | None
    free_transfers_available: int | None
    transfers_made: int | None
    points_hit: int | None
    players: list[PlanPlayerRecord]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanRecord:
    plan_id: int
    name: str
    start_gameweek: int
    end_gameweek: int
    initial_bank: float
    initial_free_transfers: int
    gameweeks: list[PlanGameweekRecord]
    canonical_plan: Plan | None = None
    rule_players: list[PlanPlayerRecord] = field(default_factory=list)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanSummaryRecord:
    plan_id: int
    name: str
    start_gameweek: int

    created_at: dt.datetime

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PlanPlayerSave:
