class FakePlanRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._plans: dict[int, _StoredPlan] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    def list_plans(self) -> list[PlanSummaryRecord]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def get_for_view(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        return self.get(plan_id)

    def get(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        plan = self._plans.get(plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return None
        return PlanRecord(
            plan_id=plan_id,
            name=plan.name,
            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=plan.initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=plan.initial_free_transfers,
            gameweeks=[
                PlanGameweekRecord(
                    gameweek_number=number,
                    chip=stored.chip,
                    bank=stored.bank,
                    free_transfers_available=stored.free_transfers_available,
                    transfers_made=stored.transfers_made,
                    points_hit=stored.points_hit,
                    players=[
                        PlanPlayerRecord(
                            player_id=player.player_id,
                            web_name=f"P{player.player_id}",
                            first_name="First",
                            second_name="Second",
                            team_id=player.player_id,
                            team_name=f"Team {player.player_id}",
                            team_short_name="TMX",
                            position=POSITIONS[player.player_id],
                            current_price=PRICES[player.player_id],
                            status="a",
                            is_starting=player.is_starting,
                            bench_order=player.bench_order,
                            is_captain=player.is_captain,
                            is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                        )
                        for player in stored.players
                    ],
                )
                for number, stored in sorted(plan.gameweeks.items())
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._plans[plan_id] = _StoredPlan(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        return plan_id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        del self._plans[plan_id]

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        plan.gameweeks = {
            number: stored for number, stored in plan.gameweeks.items() if start <= number <= end
        }

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        self._plans[plan_id].gameweeks[gameweek_number] = _StoredGameweek(
            chip=chip,
            bank=bank,
            free_transfers_available=free_transfers_available,
            transfers_made=transfers_made,
            points_hit=points_hit,
            players=list(players),
        )

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        for entry in entries:
            stored = plan.gameweeks[entry.gameweek_number]
            stored.bank = entry.bank
            stored.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            stored.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            stored.points_hit = entry.points_hit

def test_guarded_core_handlers_and_explicit_dependency_repair(guarded_mutations, planner_session):

    from fpl_engine.rules import RuleViolationError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    initial = PlanRepository(planner_session).load_canonical(plan_id)
    owned = next(player for player in initial.boundary.players if player.player_id == 2)
    upstream = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(intents=[{

        "outgoing_ownership_id": str(owned.ownership_id), "incoming_player_id": 102,

        "kind": "add_transfer", "gameweek_number": 9, "outgoing_player_id": 102,
        "outgoing_ownership_id": str(first.incoming_ownership_id), "incoming_player_id": 2,
    }])).plan.gameweeks[1].transfers[0]

        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(3, 2, [edit]))

        "kind": "remove_transfer", "decision_id": str(downstream.decision_id),

@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("stage", ["before_acceptance", "partial_write", "uncertain_commit"])
def test_guarded_sql_fault_boundaries(guarded_mutations, planner_session, monkeypatch, stage):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from api.services.plans import PlannerMutationError
    from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    original_save = PlanRepository.save_canonical
    original_commit = planner_session.commit
    commits = 0

    def fail_acceptance(*args, **kwargs):
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected before acceptance")

    def fail_partial_write(repository, *args, **kwargs):
        original_save(repository, *args, **kwargs)
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected after canonical flush")

    def uncertain_commit():
        nonlocal commits
        original_commit()
        commits += 1
        if commits == 2:
            raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected lost COMMIT acknowledgement")

    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "accept_mutation", fail_acceptance)
    elif stage == "partial_write":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "save_canonical", fail_partial_write)
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr(planner_session, "commit", uncertain_commit)
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as failed:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    expected = {
        "before_acceptance": "not_accepted",
        "partial_write": "accepted_not_saved",
        "uncertain_commit": "outcome_unknown",
    }[stage]
    assert failed.value.code == expected
    monkeypatch.undo()
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id).revision == int(stage == "uncertain_commit")
    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        assert repository.get_receipt(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id) is None
    else:
        lookup = service.lookup(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id)
        assert lookup.status == (
            "already_committed" if stage == "uncertain_commit" else "accepted_not_saved"
        )
        assert service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body()).committed_revision == 1

        if plan is None:

        return PlanRecord(
            plan_id=plan_id,

            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=plan.initial_bank,

                    transfers_made=stored.transfers_made,

                    players=[
                        PlanPlayerRecord(
                            player_id=player.player_id,
                            web_name=f"P{player.player_id}",
                            first_name="First",
                            second_name="Second",
                            team_id=player.player_id,
                            team_name=f"Team {player.player_id}",
                            team_short_name="TMX",
                            position=POSITIONS[player.player_id],
                            current_price=PRICES[player.player_id],
                            status="a",
                            is_starting=player.is_starting,
                            bench_order=player.bench_order,
                            is_captain=player.is_captain,
                            is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                        )
                        for player in stored.players
                    ],
                )
                for number, stored in sorted(plan.gameweeks.items())
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._plans[plan_id] = _StoredPlan(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        return plan_id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        del self._plans[plan_id]

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        plan.gameweeks = {
            number: stored for number, stored in plan.gameweeks.items() if start <= number <= end
        }

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        self._plans[plan_id].gameweeks[gameweek_number] = _StoredGameweek(
            chip=chip,
            bank=bank,
            free_transfers_available=free_transfers_available,
            transfers_made=transfers_made,
            points_hit=points_hit,
            players=list(players),
        )

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        for entry in entries:
            stored = plan.gameweeks[entry.gameweek_number]
            stored.bank = entry.bank
            stored.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            stored.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            stored.points_hit = entry.points_hit

@pytest.mark.parametrize("duplicate", [False, True])
def test_real_sql_competing_revisions_and_duplicate_final_lock(
    planner_session,
    planner_plan,
    planner_metadata,
    monkeypatch,
    duplicate,
):
    from uuid import UUID

    from api.repositories.squad_player_lookup_repository import SquadPlayerLookupRepository
    from api.schemas.plans import PlanMutationRequestBody
    from api.services.plans import PlanMutationService, PlannerMutationError
    from conftest import seed_planner_players
    from fpl_engine.planning.evaluate import evaluate_plan
    from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

    seed_planner_players(planner_session, planner_metadata)
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    plan_id = repository.create(
        name=planner_plan.name,
        start_gameweek=8,
        end_gameweek=10,
        initial_bank=1.0,
        initial_free_transfers=1,
    )
    repository.save_canonical(plan_id, planner_plan, evaluate_plan(planner_plan, planner_metadata))
    planner_session.commit()
    engine = planner_session.get_bind()
    rendezvous = Barrier(2, timeout=10)
    original = PlanMutationService._commit
    commits: dict[int, int] = {}

    def synchronized_acceptance(service):
        original(service)
        identity = id(service)
        commits[identity] = commits.get(identity, 0) + 1
        if commits[identity] == 1:
            rendezvous.wait()

    monkeypatch.setattr(PlanMutationService, "_commit", synchronized_acceptance)

    def worker(number):
        with Session(engine) as session:
            service = PlanMutationService(session, SquadPlayerLookupRepository(session))
            body = PlanMutationRequestBody.model_validate(
                {
                    "mutation_id": str(UUID(int=1 if duplicate else number)),
                    "expected_revision": 0,
                    "intents": [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Concurrent"}],
                }
            )
            try:
                return service.mutate(plan_id, body).status
            except PlannerMutationError as error:
                return error.code

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
        outcomes = sorted(executor.map(worker, [1, 2]))
    assert outcomes == (
        ["already_committed", "committed"]
        if duplicate
        else ["committed", "stale_reprepare_required"]
    )
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id).revision == 1

        if "FOR UPDATE" in statement:
            attempting_lock.set()

    def writer():
        with Session(engine) as session:
            request = PlanMutationRequestBody.model_validate({
                "mutation_id": str(UUID(int=9000)), "expected_revision": 0,
                "intents": [{"kind": "correct_purchase_price",
                    "ownership_id": str(snapshot.boundary.players[0].ownership_id), "price_tenths": 49}],
            })
            return PlanMutationService(session, SquadPlayerLookupRepository(session)).mutate(plan_id, request)

    event.listen(engine, "before_cursor_execute", on_statement)
    try:
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
            future = executor.submit(writer)
            try:
                assert attempting_lock.wait(10)
                assert not future.done()
                coherent = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
                assert coherent.revision == 0
                assert coherent.boundary.players[0].purchase_price_tenths == 50
            finally:
                planner_session.rollback()
            assert future.result(timeout=10).committed_revision == 1
        reopened = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
        assert reopened.revision == 1
        assert reopened.boundary.players[0].purchase_price_tenths == 49
    finally:
        event.remove(engine, "before_cursor_execute", on_statement)


def new_plan(session: Session) -> PlanModel:
    plan = PlanModel(name="SQL plan", start_gameweek=8, end_gameweek=9)
    session.add(plan)
    session.flush()
    return plan


def test_receipt_identity_constraints_and_plan_delete_cascade(planner_session: Session) -> None:
    from api.models.entities import PlanMutationModel

    plan = new_plan(planner_session)
    mutation_id = UUID(int=1)
    receipt = PlanMutationModel(
        plan_id=plan.id,
        mutation_id=mutation_id,
        digest="a" * 64,
        expected_revision=0,
        status="validated_pending",
        evaluator_version="test",
        rule_fingerprint="b" * 64,
        pending_inputs={"intents": []},
    )
    planner_session.add(receipt)
    planner_session.flush()
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError), planner_session.begin_nested():
        planner_session.add(
            PlanMutationModel(
                plan_id=plan.id,
                mutation_id=mutation_id,
                digest="c" * 64,
                expected_revision=0,
                status="validated_pending",
                evaluator_version="test",
                rule_fingerprint="b" * 64,
                pending_inputs={"intents": []},
            )
        )
        planner_session.flush()
    planner_session.execute(delete(PlanModel).where(PlanModel.id == plan.id))
    assert planner_session.scalars(select(PlanMutationModel)).all() == []


def test_nullable_canonical_chip_is_independent_of_legacy_chip(planner_session: Session) -> None:
    from api.models.entities import PlanChip

    plan = new_plan(planner_session)
    week = PlanGameweekModel(
        plan_id=plan.id, gameweek_number=8, chip=PlanChip.WILDCARD, planned_chip=None
    )
    planner_session.add(week)
    planner_session.flush()
    planner_session.expire_all()
    stored = planner_session.get(PlanGameweekModel, week.id)
    assert stored.planned_chip is None
    assert stored.chip == PlanChip.WILDCARD


@pytest.mark.parametrize("revision", [-1])
def test_revision_cannot_be_negative(planner_session: Session, revision: int) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError), planner_session.begin_nested():
        planner_session.add(
            PlanModel(name="Invalid", start_gameweek=8, end_gameweek=9, revision=revision)
        )
        planner_session.flush()


def test_canonical_load_and_rollback_are_independent_of_legacy_fields(
    planner_session: Session, planner_plan: Plan, planner_metadata: dict[int, PlayerRuleData]
) -> None:
    from dataclasses import replace

    seed_players(planner_session, planner_metadata)
    stored = new_plan(planner_session)
    plan_id = stored.id
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    repository.save_canonical(plan_id, planner_plan, evaluate_plan(planner_plan, planner_metadata))
    planner_session.commit()
    loaded = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
    assert loaded == planner_plan
    assert stored.initial_bank == 0.0
    assert stored.initial_free_transfers == 1
    repository.save_canonical(
        plan_id,
        replace(planner_plan, name="Uncommitted", revision=1),
        evaluate_plan(planner_plan, planner_metadata),
    )
    planner_session.rollback()
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id) == planner_plan


def test_pending_receipt_contains_only_inputs_and_commit_drops_redundant_payload(
    planner_session: Session,
) -> None:
    from api.models.entities import PlanMutationModel

    plan = new_plan(planner_session)
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    receipt = repository.accept_mutation(
        plan.id,
        UUID(int=7),
        digest="a" * 64,
        expected_revision=0,
        evaluator_version="test",
        rule_fingerprint="b" * 64,
        pending_inputs={"intents": [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Renamed"}]},
    )
    planner_session.commit()
    assert repository.get_receipt(plan.id, UUID(int=7)).pending_inputs == {
        "intents": [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Renamed"}]
    }
    repository.commit_mutation(receipt, 1)
    planner_session.commit()
    stored = planner_session.get(PlanMutationModel, receipt.id)
    assert stored.pending_inputs is None
    assert stored.committed_revision == 1
    assert stored.digest == "a" * 64

from __future__ import annotations

from api.services.plan_accounting import (
    PlanGameweekState,
    apply_transfers_forward,
    pair_transfers,
    recalculate_accounting,
)
from builders import POSITIONS, PRICES, build_squad, transfer
from fpl_engine.rules import Chip


def _state(gameweek_number: int, players: list, chip: Chip | None = None) -> PlanGameweekState:
    return PlanGameweekState(gameweek_number=gameweek_number, chip=chip, players=tuple(players))


def _recalculate(states: list[PlanGameweekState], *, bank: float = 0.5, free_transfers: int = 1):
    return recalculate_accounting(
        states,
        initial_bank=bank,
        initial_free_transfers=free_transfers,
        prices=PRICES,
    )


class TestRecalculateAccounting:
    def test_first_gameweek_uses_the_plan_starting_position(self) -> None:
        result = _recalculate([_state(1, build_squad())])

        assert result[0].bank == 0.5
        assert result[0].free_transfers_available == 1
        assert result[0].transfers_made == 0
        assert result[0].points_hit == 0

    def test_unused_transfers_accumulate_from_gameweek_two(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        result = _recalculate([_state(number, squad) for number in range(1, 8)])

        assert [entry.free_transfers_available for entry in result] == [1, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 5]

    def test_gameweek_one_transfers_are_free(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        after = transfer(transfer(squad, out_id=12, in_id=16), out_id=11, in_id=17)
        result = _recalculate([_state(1, after)], free_transfers=0)

        assert result[0].points_hit == 0

    def test_plans_starting_later_keep_their_banked_transfers(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        result = _recalculate([_state(number, squad) for number in range(6, 9)], free_transfers=2)

        assert [entry.free_transfers_available for entry in result] == [2, 3, 4]

    def test_transfer_is_detected_and_priced(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        after = transfer(squad, out_id=12, in_id=16)
        result = _recalculate([_state(1, squad), _state(2, after)])

        assert result[1].transfers_made == 1
        assert result[1].players_out == (12,)
        assert result[1].players_in == (16,)
        assert result[1].bank == 0.5 + PRICES[12] - PRICES[16]

    def test_extra_transfers_cost_four_points_each(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        after = transfer(
            transfer(transfer(squad, out_id=12, in_id=16), out_id=11, in_id=17),
            out_id=10,
            in_id=20,
        )
        result = _recalculate([_state(1, squad), _state(2, after)])

        assert result[1].free_transfers_available == 1
        assert result[1].transfers_made == 3
        assert result[1].points_hit == 8

    def test_wildcard_gameweek_costs_nothing_and_preserves_transfers(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        after = transfer(
            transfer(transfer(squad, out_id=12, in_id=16), out_id=11, in_id=17),
            out_id=10,
            in_id=20,
        )
        result = _recalculate([_state(1, squad), _state(2, after, Chip.WILDCARD), _state(3, after)])

        assert result[1].points_hit == 0
        assert result[2].free_transfers_available == 1

    def test_free_hit_squad_reverts_the_following_gameweek(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        free_hit_squad = transfer(squad, out_id=12, in_id=16)
        result = _recalculate(
            [
                _state(1, squad),
                _state(2, free_hit_squad, Chip.FREE_HIT),
                _state(3, squad),
            ]
        )

        assert result[1].transfers_made == 1
        assert result[2].transfers_made == 0
        assert result[2].bank == 0.5


class TestPairTransfers:
    def test_pairs_by_position_when_possible(self) -> None:
        pairs = pair_transfers([12, 14], [18, 16], POSITIONS)

        assert pairs == {12: 16, 14: 18}

    def test_falls_back_when_positions_do_not_match(self) -> None:
        pairs = pair_transfers([12], [18], POSITIONS)

        assert pairs == {12: 18}


class TestApplyTransfersForward:
    def test_later_gameweeks_inherit_the_transfer(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        states = [_state(number, squad) for number in range(1, 4)]

        updated = apply_transfers_forward(states, from_index=0, pairs={12: 16})

        assert all(16 in state.player_ids for state in updated[1:])
        assert all(12 not in state.player_ids for state in updated[1:])

    def test_earlier_gameweeks_are_untouched(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        states = [_state(number, squad) for number in range(1, 4)]

        updated = apply_transfers_forward(states, from_index=1, pairs={12: 16})

        assert 12 in updated[0].player_ids
        assert 16 not in updated[0].player_ids

    def test_gameweek_that_already_moved_the_player_on_is_left_alone(self) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        later = transfer(squad, out_id=12, in_id=17)
        states = [_state(1, squad), _state(2, later)]

        updated = apply_transfers_forward(states, from_index=0, pairs={12: 16})

        assert 17 in updated[1].player_ids
        assert 16 not in updated[1].player_ids

# Planner Foundations API And Mutation Contract

Revised 2026-10-14. [spec.md](../spec.md) is fixed product intent; [data-model.md](../data-model.md) defines canonical inputs/replay. Integer `_tenths` fields represent money. This design has one public mutation operation for changes to an existing plan, no public prepare/commit protocol and no writable full-squad compatibility surface.

Retain list/detail GET, POST creation and DELETE. Creation captures saved My Team membership/bank into an independent boundary, defaults starting FT to 1 after GW1 (N/A at GW1), and initializes unknown purchase prices as nonblocking assumptions. It does not copy My Team's FT default. Creation/deletion retain their ordinary resource semantics; the mutation retry contract below covers existing-plan autosave.

Retire `PATCH /plans/{plan_id}` and `PUT /plans/{plan_id}/gameweeks/{gw}` from mutation: return **410 Gone**, structured `planner_writer_retired`, with the new mutation route. No adapter, implicit identity, snapshot-diff fallback or weaker writer remains. Update all Planner name/horizon/GW callers and tests in the same rollout. An old browser must reload/update; old writes cannot partially mutate canonical or quarantined legacy data. Public per-mutation commit endpoints are not introduced.
Read a coherent aggregate/revision in one consistent database snapshot, not revision N with child rows from N+1. GET replays canonical boundary/decisions and returns:
| `revision`, `evaluator_version` | Ordering/evaluation compatibility, not a historical version browser. |
| `starting_state` | Independent membership/slots/bank/bases/provenance, FT/chip declarations, boundary/legacy assumption source. |
| `gameweeks[].decisions` | Explicit transfer IDs, outgoing ownership bindings, incoming acquisitions and saved price inputs; chip and local lineup choices. |

Live market/projection enrichment may change; saved market assumptions/acquisition prices and bank cannot change merely on refresh. Pending receipts do not alter canonical GET output.

An incoming player selected again in the same GW edits its original acquisition decision, not a new same-GW sale/round trip. Expose source decision IDs so the client can submit that explicit edit. A batch of purchase corrections/confirmations cannot include planning mutations: reject mixed batches, commit Q7 corrections first, and validate later planning repairs against their acknowledged revision. Merely including a correction never exempts a new transfer from Q2.

2. For a new ID, check expected revision, capture only new/explicitly edited prices and evaluate the whole candidate with the engine. Reject new structural violations and new/worse per-GW shortfalls under Q2; Q7 allows financially worsening provenance correction. Return affected-GW/decision diagnostics for rejected upstream dependencies, not an accepted invalid draft.

3. Durably record a valid `validated_pending` receipt containing the operation and necessary frozen financial inputs. This is the acceptance boundary, not a canonical-plan update. Do not claim acceptance if receipt persistence failed.

4. In a second bounded transaction, lock/reload the plan and receipt. Recheck receipt status/digest under this lock before checking the base: if a duplicate request committed meanwhile, return `already_committed` without writing, not a stale-base error. Otherwise recheck compatible revision and rule context, replay using saved observations, then atomically save canonical inputs, required selling-price materializations, revision+1 and the committed receipt. No half-recalculated plan may persist. The server automatically performs both stages in this one HTTP call.

5. A known canonical-write rollback after stage 3 returns accepted-but-not-saved; the pending receipt preserves the same quote for retry. A race advancing the revision instead returns explicit stale status. Do not treat either as a successful save.

The small private pending stage is retained because a lone rolled-back transaction cannot durably preserve an accepted quote for retry. It replaces client-visible prepare/commit, not canonical transaction atomicity. No aggregate history is stored, and ordinary successful autosave takes one request.

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest
from api.db.session import get_db_session
from api.main import app
from api.repositories.my_team_projection_repository import PlayerProjectionFixtureRecord
from api.routers.plans import (
    get_create_plan_service,
    get_delete_plan_service,
    get_get_plan_service,
    get_list_plans_service,
    get_plan_view_service,
    get_save_plan_gameweek_service,
    get_update_plan_service,
)
from api.services.get_plan_view import GetPlanViewService
from api.services.plans import (
    CreatePlanService,
    DeletePlanService,
    GetPlanService,
    ListPlansService,
    SavePlanGameweekService,
    UpdatePlanService,
)
from builders import FakePlayerLookupRepository, build_squad
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from test_plan_services import FakeCurrentSquadRepository, FakePlanRepository
from test_plan_services import guarded_mutations as guarded_mutations


class _FakeSession:
    def commit(self) -> None:
        return None

    def rollback(self) -> None:
        return None


class _EmptyProjectionRepository:
    def list_latest_player_fixture_projections(
        self, player_ids: list[int]
    ) -> list[PlayerProjectionFixtureRecord]:
        return []


def _squad_payload() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [
        {
            "player_id": player.player_id,
            "is_starting": player.is_starting,
            "bench_order": player.bench_order,
            "is_captain": player.is_captain,
            "is_vice_captain": player.is_vice_captain,
        }
        for player in build_squad()
    ]


def _client(repository: FakePlanRepository) -> TestClient:
    app.dependency_overrides[get_db_session] = lambda: _FakeSession()
    app.dependency_overrides[get_plan_view_service] = lambda: GetPlanViewService(
        _EmptyProjectionRepository()
    )
    app.dependency_overrides[get_list_plans_service] = lambda: ListPlansService(repository)
    app.dependency_overrides[get_get_plan_service] = lambda: GetPlanService(repository)
    app.dependency_overrides[get_create_plan_service] = lambda: CreatePlanService(
        repository, FakeCurrentSquadRepository()
    )
    app.dependency_overrides[get_update_plan_service] = lambda: UpdatePlanService(repository)
    app.dependency_overrides[get_delete_plan_service] = lambda: DeletePlanService(repository)
    app.dependency_overrides[get_save_plan_gameweek_service] = lambda: SavePlanGameweekService(
        repository, FakePlayerLookupRepository()
    )
    return TestClient(app)


def _create_plan(client: TestClient) -> int:
    response = client.post(
        "/plans",
        json={"name": "No Haaland GW1", "start_gameweek": 1, "end_gameweek": 4},
    )
    assert response.status_code == 201
    plan_id: int = response.json()["plan_id"]
    return plan_id


def teardown_function() -> None:
    app.dependency_overrides.clear()


def test_create_plan_returns_every_gameweek() -> None:
    client = _client(FakePlanRepository())

    response = client.post(
        "/plans",
        json={"name": "No Haaland GW1", "start_gameweek": 1, "end_gameweek": 4},
    )

    body = response.json()
    assert response.status_code == 201
    assert body["name"] == "No Haaland GW1"
    assert [gameweek["gameweek_number"] for gameweek in body["gameweeks"]] == [1, 2, 3, 4]


def test_get_plan_returns_404_when_missing() -> None:
    client = _client(FakePlanRepository())

    assert client.get("/plans/99").status_code == 404


def test_rename_plan() -> None:
    client = _client(FakePlanRepository())
    plan_id = _create_plan(client)

    response = client.patch(f"/plans/{plan_id}", json={"name": "Haaland In GW2"})

    assert response.status_code == 410
    assert response.json()["detail"]["code"] == "planner_writer_retired"


def test_adjusting_the_horizon_extends_the_plan() -> None:
    client = _client(FakePlanRepository())
    plan_id = _create_plan(client)

    response = client.patch(f"/plans/{plan_id}", json={"end_gameweek": 6})

    assert response.status_code == 410
    assert response.json()["detail"]["code"] == "planner_writer_retired"


def test_save_gameweek_with_chip() -> None:
    client = _client(FakePlanRepository())
    plan_id = _create_plan(client)

    response = client.put(
        f"/plans/{plan_id}/gameweeks/2",
        json={"chip": "BENCH_BOOST", "players": _squad_payload()},
    )

    assert response.status_code == 410
    assert response.json()["detail"]["code"] == "planner_writer_retired"


def test_retired_writer_never_validates_or_accepts_a_squad_payload() -> None:
    client = _client(FakePlanRepository())
    plan_id = _create_plan(client)
    payload = _squad_payload()
    expensive = next(player for player in payload if player["player_id"] == 12)
    expensive["player_id"] = 21

    response = client.put(
        f"/plans/{plan_id}/gameweeks/2",
        json={"chip": None, "players": payload},
    )

    assert response.status_code == 410
    assert response.json()["detail"]["code"] == "planner_writer_retired"


def test_delete_plan() -> None:
    repository = FakePlanRepository()
    client = _client(repository)
    plan_id = _create_plan(client)

    assert client.delete(f"/plans/{plan_id}").status_code == 204
    assert repository.get(plan_id) is None


@pytest.fixture
def guarded_client(request, planner_session):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from api.routers.plans import get_plan_repository

    service, plan_id = request.getfixturevalue("guarded_mutations")
    from api.routers.plans import get_plan_mutation_service

    app.dependency_overrides[get_db_session] = lambda: planner_session
    app.dependency_overrides[get_plan_repository] = lambda: PlanRepository(planner_session)
    app.dependency_overrides[get_plan_mutation_service] = lambda: service
    app.dependency_overrides[get_plan_view_service] = lambda: GetPlanViewService(
        _EmptyProjectionRepository()
    )
    with TestClient(app) as client:
        yield client, plan_id


@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_guarded_http_contracts_and_canonical_get(guarded_client):
    from test_plan_services import mutation_body

    client, plan_id = guarded_client
    body = mutation_body().model_dump(mode="json")
    response = client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert response.json()["status"] == "committed"
    assert response.json()["plan"]["revision"] == 1
    current = client.get(f"/plans/{plan_id}")
    assert current.status_code == 200
    assert current.json()["starting_state"]["free_transfers"] == 1
    assert (
        client.get(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations/{body['mutation_id']}").json()["status"]
        == "already_committed"
    )
    assert (
        client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=body).json()["status"]
        == "already_committed"
    )
    stale = mutation_body(2).model_dump(mode="json")
    assert (
        client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=stale).json()["detail"]["code"]
        == "revision_conflict"
    )
    invalid = mutation_body(3, 1, [{"kind": "set_starting_transfers", "value": None}]).model_dump(
        mode="json"
    )
    domain = client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=invalid)
    assert domain.status_code == 422
    assert isinstance(domain.json()["detail"], dict)
    invalid["expected_revision"] = True
    schema = client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=invalid)
    assert schema.status_code == 422
    assert isinstance(schema.json()["detail"], list)
    assert (
        client.get(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000009999").status_code
        == 404
    )


@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_guarded_committed_response_loss_is_reconciled_without_second_write(
    guarded_client, monkeypatch
):
    from test_plan_services import mutation_body

    client, plan_id = guarded_client
    original = GetPlanViewService.execute

    def lose_enrichment(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("Injected post-commit enrichment failure")

    monkeypatch.setattr(GetPlanViewService, "execute", lose_enrichment)
    body = mutation_body().model_dump(mode="json")
    response = client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 503
    assert response.json()["detail"]["code"] == "outcome_unknown"
    monkeypatch.setattr(GetPlanViewService, "execute", original)
    receipt = client.get(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations/{body['mutation_id']}")
    assert receipt.status_code == 200
    assert receipt.json()["committed_revision"] == 1

def test_retired_writers_change_no_sql_rows_and_never_open_database_dependency(

    from api.models.entities import (

              PlanTransferDecisionModel, PlanMutationModel)

        return [list(planner_session.execute(select(model.__table__).order_by(model.id)).mappings())
                for model in models]

    client, plan_id = guarded_client

    response = client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=body)

    assert (
        client.get(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations/{body['mutation_id']}").json()["status"]
        == "already_committed"
    )
    assert (
        client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=body).json()["status"]
        == "already_committed"
    )
    stale = mutation_body(2).model_dump(mode="json")
    assert (
        client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=stale).json()["detail"]["code"]
        == "revision_conflict"
    )
    invalid = mutation_body(3, 1, [{"kind": "set_starting_transfers", "value": None}]).model_dump(
        mode="json"
    )
    domain = client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=invalid)
    assert domain.status_code == 422
    assert isinstance(domain.json()["detail"], dict)
    invalid["expected_revision"] = True
    schema = client.post(f"/plans/{plan_id}/mutations", json=invalid)
    assert schema.status_code == 422

):

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import replace
from uuid import UUID

import pytest
from fpl_engine.domain import PlayerPosition
from fpl_engine.planning.models import (
    Boundary,
    GameweekDecision,
    Plan,
    PlayerRuleData,
    TransferDecision,
)
from fpl_engine.rules import RuleViolationError, SquadSlot, validate_squad

POSITIONS = (
    PlayerPosition.GOALKEEPER,
    *([PlayerPosition.DEFENDER] * 4),
    *([PlayerPosition.MIDFIELDER] * 4),
    *([PlayerPosition.FORWARD] * 2),
    PlayerPosition.GOALKEEPER,
    PlayerPosition.DEFENDER,
    PlayerPosition.MIDFIELDER,
    PlayerPosition.FORWARD,
)


def identity(number: int) -> UUID:
    return UUID(int=number)


def build_players() -> dict[int, SquadSlot]:
    players = {
        index + 1: SquadSlot(
            player_id=index + 1,
            position=position,
            team_id=index % 5 + 1,
            is_starting=index < 11,
            bench_order=None if index < 11 else index - 10,
            is_captain=index == 1,
            is_vice_captain=index == 2,
        )
        for index, position in enumerate(POSITIONS)
    }
    return players | {
        player_id + 100: replace(player, player_id=player_id + 100, team_id=20 + player_id)
        for player_id, player in players.items()
    }


def test_fixture_is_a_legal_multi_club_squad() -> None:
    players = build_players()
    validate_squad(list(players.values())[:15])
    assert len({player.team_id for player in list(players.values())[:15]}) == 5
    assert players[102].position == players[2].position
    assert identity(1) == UUID("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", range(6))
def test_starting_state_accepts_whole_remaining_transfers_including_zero(value: int) -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import SetStartingTransfers
    from fpl_engine.planning.mutations import apply_intents

    plan = build_plan(12, 13)
    assert plan.boundary.free_transfers == 1
    result = apply_intents(plan, (SetStartingTransfers(value),), metadata())
    assert result.plan.boundary.free_transfers == value
    assert result.evaluation.gameweeks[0].free_transfers_available == value
    assert result.evaluation.gameweeks[0].next_free_transfers == min(5, value + 1)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", [-1, 6, 1.5, True, None])
def test_starting_state_rejects_invalid_remaining_transfers(value: object) -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import SetStartingTransfers
    from fpl_engine.planning.mutations import apply_intents

    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        apply_intents(build_plan(12, 13), (SetStartingTransfers(value),), metadata())


@pytest.mark.parametrize("start", [1, 20])
def test_period_boundary_disallows_used_chips_and_gw1_requires_na(start: int) -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import SetStartingChips, SetStartingTransfers
    from fpl_engine.planning.mutations import apply_intents
    from fpl_engine.rules import Chip

    plan = build_plan(start, start + 1)
    if start == 1:
        plan = replace(plan, boundary=replace(plan.boundary, free_transfers=None))
        result = apply_intents(plan, (SetStartingTransfers(None),), metadata())
        assert result.evaluation.gameweeks[0].unlimited_transfers
        assert result.evaluation.gameweeks[1].free_transfers_available == 1
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError, match="N/A"):
            apply_intents(plan, (SetStartingTransfers(1),), metadata())
    for chip in Chip:
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError, match="No used chips"):
            apply_intents(plan, (SetStartingChips(frozenset({chip}), False),), metadata())


def test_starting_state_fh19_is_applicable_only_at_twenty() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import SetStartingChips
    from fpl_engine.planning.mutations import apply_intents
    from fpl_engine.rules import Chip
    from fpl_engine.rules.chips import chip_states

    result = apply_intents(
        build_plan(20, 21), (SetStartingChips(frozenset(), True),), metadata()
    )
    assert result.plan.boundary.free_hit_gameweek_19
    state = chip_states(20, {}, start_gameweek=20, free_hit_gameweek_19=True)[Chip.FREE_HIT]
    assert state.state == "rule_unavailable"
    assert state.conflicting_gameweek == 19
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError, match="only applicable"):
        apply_intents(build_plan(25, 26), (SetStartingChips(frozenset(), True),), metadata())


def test_starting_state_used_chips_apply_to_the_starting_period_only() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import SetStartingChips
    from fpl_engine.planning.mutations import apply_intents
    from fpl_engine.rules import Chip
    from fpl_engine.rules.chips import chip_states

    for start in (12, 25):
        result = apply_intents(
            build_plan(start, start + 1),
            (SetStartingChips(frozenset({Chip.WILDCARD}), False),),
            metadata(),
        )
        states = chip_states(start, {}, start_gameweek=start,
                            used_chips=result.plan.boundary.used_chips)
        assert states[Chip.WILDCARD].state == "used_before"
        if start == 12:
            assert chip_states(20, {}, start_gameweek=start,
                               used_chips=result.plan.boundary.used_chips)[
                                   Chip.WILDCARD].state == "available"


def test_contradictory_starting_chip_names_planned_gameweek_and_changes_nothing() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import SetStartingChips
    from fpl_engine.planning.mutations import MutationRejectedError, apply_intents
    from fpl_engine.rules import Chip

    plan = with_week(build_plan(12, 19), 18, chip=Chip.WILDCARD)
    with pytest.raises(MutationRejectedError, match="Gameweek 18") as rejected:
        apply_intents(plan, (SetStartingChips(frozenset({Chip.WILDCARD}), False),), metadata())
    assert rejected.value.diagnostics[0].gameweek_number == 18
    assert plan.gameweeks[6].chip == Chip.WILDCARD
    assert not plan.boundary.used_chips


def build_boundary() -> Boundary:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import Boundary, LineupRole, Ownership, PurchaseProvenance

    players = tuple(
        Ownership(
            slot_id=identity(player_id),
            ownership_id=identity(1000 + player_id),
            player_id=player_id,
            purchase_price_tenths=50,
            provenance=PurchaseProvenance("stored_player_observation", 50),
        )
        for player_id in range(1, 16)
    )
    lineup = tuple(
        LineupRole(
            identity(player.player_id),
            player.is_starting,
            player.bench_order,
            player.is_captain,
            player.is_vice_captain,
        )
        for player in list(build_players().values())[:15]
    )
    return Boundary(players, lineup, 10, 1)


def build_transfer(outgoing: int = 2, incoming: int = 102, number: int = 1) -> TransferDecision:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import TransferDecision

    return TransferDecision(
        identity(2000 + number),
        outgoing,
        identity(1000 + outgoing),
        incoming,
        identity(3000 + number),
        54,
        50,
        "stored_player_observation",
        "2026-10-14T12:00:00+00:00",
        "captured",
    )


def test_boundary_contract_has_independent_stable_slots() -> None:
    boundary = build_boundary()
    assert len(boundary.players) == 15
    assert len({player.slot_id for player in boundary.players}) == 15
    assert boundary.players[0].provenance.confirmation == "assumed"
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError, match="15"):
        replace(boundary, players=boundary.players[:14])
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        replace(boundary, players=(boundary.players[0],) + boundary.players[:-1])
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        replace(boundary.players[0], slot_id="invalid")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("price", [0, -1, 5.5, True])
def test_price_inputs_must_be_positive_whole_tenths(price: object) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        replace(build_boundary().players[0], purchase_price_tenths=price)


def test_net_set_rejects_duplicate_changes_and_round_trips() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import GameweekDecision

    boundary = build_boundary()
    transfer = build_transfer()
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        GameweekDecision(8, boundary.lineup, (transfer, transfer))
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        GameweekDecision(8, boundary.lineup, (transfer, build_transfer(102, 2, 2)))


def test_planned_acquisition_provenance_is_not_an_estimated_historical_purchase() -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import PurchaseProvenance

    provenance = PurchaseProvenance("decision:example", 52, "planned_acquisition", None)
    assert provenance.confirmation is None
    assert provenance.original_price_tenths == 52
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
        replace(provenance, confirmation="assumed")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("market", "sale"), [(48, 48), (50, 50), (51, 50), (52, 51), (53, 51), (54, 52)]
)
def test_official_sale_steps(market: int, sale: int) -> None:
    from fpl_engine.planning.prices import selling_price_tenths

    assert selling_price_tenths(50, market) == sale


def build_plan(start: int = 8, end: int = 11) -> Plan:
    boundary = build_boundary()
    return Plan(
        "Test plan",
        start,
        end,
        boundary,
        tuple(GameweekDecision(number, boundary.lineup) for number in range(start, end + 1)),
    )


def metadata() -> dict[int, PlayerRuleData]:
    return {
        player_id: PlayerRuleData(player_id, player.position, player.team_id)
        for player_id, player in build_players().items()
    }


def with_week(plan: Plan, number: int, **changes) -> Plan:
    return replace(
        plan,
        gameweeks=tuple(
            replace(week, **changes) if week.gameweek_number == number else week
            for week in plan.gameweeks

def test_guarded_core_handlers_and_explicit_dependency_repair(guarded_mutations, planner_session):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from fpl_engine.rules import RuleViolationError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    initial = PlanRepository(planner_session).load_canonical(plan_id)
    owned = next(player for player in initial.boundary.players if player.player_id == 2)
    upstream = service.mutate(
        plan_id,
        mutation_body(
            intents=[
                {
                    "kind": "add_transfer",
                    "gameweek_number": 8,
                    "outgoing_player_id": 2,
                    "outgoing_ownership_id": str(owned.ownership_id),
                    "incoming_player_id": 102,
                }
            ]
        ),
    ).plan
    first = upstream.gameweeks[0].transfers[0]
    downstream = (
        service.mutate(
            plan_id,
            mutation_body(
                2,
                1,
                [
                    {
                        "kind": "add_transfer",
                        "gameweek_number": 9,
                        "outgoing_player_id": 102,
                        "outgoing_ownership_id": str(first.incoming_ownership_id),
                        "incoming_player_id": 2,
                    }
                ],
            ),
        )
        .plan.gameweeks[1]
        .transfers[0]
    )
    edit = {
        "kind": "edit_transfer",
        "decision_id": str(first.decision_id),
        "incoming_player_id": 103,
    }
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError, match="Gameweek 9"):
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(3, 2, [edit]))
    repaired = service.mutate(
        plan_id,
        mutation_body(
            4,
            2,
            [
                edit,
                {
                    "kind": "remove_transfer",
                    "decision_id": str(downstream.decision_id),
                },
            ],
        ),
    ).plan
    assert repaired.revision == 3
    assert not repaired.gameweeks[1].transfers
    frozen = repaired.gameweeks[0].transfers
    operations = [
        {"kind": "activate_chip", "gameweek_number": 8, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "move_chip", "source_gameweek": 8, "target_gameweek": 9, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "remove_chip", "gameweek_number": 9, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "change_captain", "gameweek_number": 8, "player_id": 4},
        {"kind": "change_horizon", "start_gameweek": 9, "end_gameweek": 11},
    ]
    for number, operation in enumerate(operations, start=5):
        result = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(number, number - 2, [operation]))
    assert result.plan.revision == 8
    assert result.plan.start_gameweek == 9
    assert any(player.player_id == 103 for player in result.plan.boundary.players)
    assert frozen[0].observation_source in next(
        player.provenance.source
        for player in result.plan.boundary.players
        if player.player_id == 103
    )
    assert PlanRepository(planner_session).load_canonical(plan_id) == result.plan

@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("stage", ["before_acceptance", "partial_write", "uncertain_commit"])
def test_guarded_sql_fault_boundaries(guarded_mutations, planner_session, monkeypatch, stage):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from api.services.plans import PlannerMutationError
    from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    original_save = PlanRepository.save_canonical
    original_commit = planner_session.commit
    commits = 0

    def fail_acceptance(*args, **kwargs):
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected before acceptance")

    def fail_partial_write(repository, *args, **kwargs):
        original_save(repository, *args, **kwargs)
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected after canonical flush")

    def uncertain_commit():
        nonlocal commits
        original_commit()
        commits += 1
        if commits == 2:
            raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected lost COMMIT acknowledgement")

    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "accept_mutation", fail_acceptance)
    elif stage == "partial_write":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "save_canonical", fail_partial_write)
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr(planner_session, "commit", uncertain_commit)
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as failed:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    expected = {
        "before_acceptance": "not_accepted",
        "partial_write": "accepted_not_saved",
        "uncertain_commit": "outcome_unknown",
    }[stage]
    assert failed.value.code == expected
    monkeypatch.undo()
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id).revision == int(stage == "uncertain_commit")
    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        assert repository.get_receipt(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id) is None
    else:
        lookup = service.lookup(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id)
        assert lookup.status == (
            "already_committed" if stage == "uncertain_commit" else "accepted_not_saved"
        )
        assert service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body()).committed_revision == 1

class FakePlanRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._plans: dict[int, _StoredPlan] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    def list_plans(self) -> list[PlanSummaryRecord]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def get_for_view(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        return self.get(plan_id)

    def get(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        plan = self._plans.get(plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return None
        return PlanRecord(
            plan_id=plan_id,
            name=plan.name,
            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=plan.initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=plan.initial_free_transfers,
            gameweeks=[
                PlanGameweekRecord(
                    gameweek_number=number,
                    chip=stored.chip,
                    bank=stored.bank,
                    free_transfers_available=stored.free_transfers_available,
                    transfers_made=stored.transfers_made,
                    points_hit=stored.points_hit,
                    players=[
                        PlanPlayerRecord(
                            player_id=player.player_id,
                            web_name=f"P{player.player_id}",
                            first_name="First",
                            second_name="Second",
                            team_id=player.player_id,
                            team_name=f"Team {player.player_id}",
                            team_short_name="TMX",
                            position=POSITIONS[player.player_id],
                            current_price=PRICES[player.player_id],
                            status="a",
                            is_starting=player.is_starting,
                            bench_order=player.bench_order,
                            is_captain=player.is_captain,
                            is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                        )
                        for player in stored.players
                    ],
                )
                for number, stored in sorted(plan.gameweeks.items())
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._plans[plan_id] = _StoredPlan(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        return plan_id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        del self._plans[plan_id]

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        plan.gameweeks = {
            number: stored for number, stored in plan.gameweeks.items() if start <= number <= end
        }

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        self._plans[plan_id].gameweeks[gameweek_number] = _StoredGameweek(
            chip=chip,
            bank=bank,
            free_transfers_available=free_transfers_available,
            transfers_made=transfers_made,
            points_hit=points_hit,
            players=list(players),
        )

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        for entry in entries:
            stored = plan.gameweeks[entry.gameweek_number]
            stored.bank = entry.bank
            stored.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            stored.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            stored.points_hit = entry.points_hit

    service = SavePlanGameweekService(repository, FakePlayerLookupRepository())
    return service.execute(
        SavePlanGameweekRequest(
            plan_id=plan_id,
            gameweek_number=gameweek_number,
            chip=chip,
            players=players,
        )
    )


class TestCreatePlan:
    def test_seeds_every_gameweek_in_the_horizon(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        plan = repository.get(plan_id)
        assert plan is not None
        assert [gameweek.gameweek_number for gameweek in plan.gameweeks] == [1, 2, 3, 4]
        assert all(len(gameweek.players) == 15 for gameweek in plan.gameweeks)

    def test_rejects_blank_name(self, repository: FakePlanRepository) -> None:
        service = CreatePlanService(repository, FakeCurrentSquadRepository())
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            service.execute(CreatePlanRequest(name="  ", start_gameweek=1, end_gameweek=4))
        assert error.value.code == "plan_name"

    def test_rejects_backwards_horizon(self, repository: FakePlanRepository) -> None:
        service = CreatePlanService(repository, FakeCurrentSquadRepository())
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            service.execute(CreatePlanRequest(name="Plan", start_gameweek=6, end_gameweek=3))
        assert error.value.code == "plan_horizon"

    def test_requires_a_saved_squad(self, repository: FakePlanRepository) -> None:
        service = CreatePlanService(repository, FakeCurrentSquadRepository(players=[]))
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            service.execute(CreatePlanRequest(name="Plan", start_gameweek=1, end_gameweek=4))
        assert error.value.code == "no_squad"


class TestUpdatePlan:
    def test_renames_a_plan(self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int) -> None:
        plan = UpdatePlanService(repository).execute(
            plan_id, UpdatePlanRequest(name="Haaland In GW2")
        )
        assert plan.name == "Haaland In GW2"

    def test_extending_the_horizon_copies_the_last_squad_forward(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        plan = UpdatePlanService(repository).execute(plan_id, UpdatePlanRequest(end_gameweek=6))

        assert [gameweek.gameweek_number for gameweek in plan.gameweeks] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]
        assert len(plan.gameweeks[-1].players) == 15

    def test_shrinking_the_horizon_drops_gameweeks(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        plan = UpdatePlanService(repository).execute(plan_id, UpdatePlanRequest(end_gameweek=2))

        assert [gameweek.gameweek_number for gameweek in plan.gameweeks] == [1, 2]

    def test_unknown_plan_raises(self, repository: FakePlanRepository) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(PlanNotFoundError):
            UpdatePlanService(repository).execute(99, UpdatePlanRequest(name="Nope"))


class TestSavePlanGameweek:
    def test_bench_and_starters_can_be_reshuffled_for_free(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        swapped = [
            player
            if player.player_id not in (14, 15)
            else PlanPlayerSelection(
                player_id=player.player_id,
                is_starting=player.player_id == 15,
                bench_order=4 if player.player_id == 14 else None,
                is_captain=player.is_captain,
                is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
            )
            for player in squad
        ]

        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, swapped)

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 0
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 0

    def test_transfer_consumes_a_free_transfer_and_carries_forward(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=17))

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 1
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 0
        assert all(
            17 in {player.player_id for player in gameweek.players}
            for gameweek in plan.gameweeks[1:]
        )

    def test_extra_transfers_in_one_gameweek_cost_four_points(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        squad = transfer(
            transfer(transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=17), out_id=11, in_id=16),
            out_id=10,
            in_id=20,
        )

        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, squad)

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 3
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 8

    def test_wildcard_removes_the_hit(self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int) -> None:
        squad = transfer(
            transfer(transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=17), out_id=11, in_id=16),
            out_id=10,
            in_id=20,
        )

        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, squad, chip="WILDCARD")

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 0
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].chip == "WILDCARD"

    def test_same_chip_cannot_be_used_twice_in_one_half(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        _save(repository, plan_id, 2, build_squad(), chip="BENCH_BOOST")

        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            _save(repository, plan_id, 3, build_squad(), chip="BENCH_BOOST")
        assert error.value.code == "chip_already_used"

    def test_transfer_that_breaks_the_budget_is_rejected(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            _save(repository, plan_id, 2, transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=21))
        assert error.value.code == "budget"

    def test_illegal_formation_is_rejected(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        squad = [
            player
            if player.player_id not in (1, 2)
            else PlanPlayerSelection(
                player_id=player.player_id,
                is_starting=True,
                bench_order=None,
                is_captain=False,
                is_vice_captain=False,
            )
            for player in build_squad()
        ]

        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError):
            _save(repository, plan_id, 2, squad)

    def test_gameweek_outside_the_plan_is_rejected(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            _save(repository, plan_id, 9, build_squad())
        assert error.value.code == "gameweek_outside_plan"

    def test_unknown_plan_raises(self, repository: FakePlanRepository) -> None:
        with pytest.raises(PlanNotFoundError):
            _save(repository, 99, 1, build_squad())

def mutation_body(number=1, revision=0, intents=None):
    import json
    from uuid import UUID

    from api.schemas.plans import PlanMutationRequestBody

    return PlanMutationRequestBody.model_validate_json(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "mutation_id": str(UUID(int=number)),
                "expected_revision": revision,
                "intents": intents or [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Renamed"}],
            }
        )
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize("start", [1, 12, 20, 25])
@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_new_plan_captures_an_independent_ready_boundary_with_default_ft(planner_session, start):
    from dataclasses import replace

    from api.models.entities import PlanGameweekPlayerModel, PlanModel
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from conftest import seed_planner_players
    from fpl_engine.domain import PlayerPosition
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import PlayerRuleData
    from sqlalchemy import func, select

    current = FakeCurrentSquadRepository().get_current()
    current = replace(current, free_transfers=4, players=[
        replace(player, team_id=player.player_id) for player in current.players
    ])
    seed_planner_players(planner_session, {
        player.player_id: PlayerRuleData(player.player_id, PlayerPosition(player.position),
                                       player.team_id) for player in current.players
    })

    class MutableSquad:
        calls = 0

        def get_current(self):
            self.calls += 1
            return current

    squad = MutableSquad()
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    record = CreatePlanService(repository, squad).execute(
        CreatePlanRequest("Independent", start, start + 1)
    )
    planner_session.commit()
    assert record.canonical_plan is not None
    captured = repository.load_canonical(record.plan_id)
    assert captured.boundary.free_transfers == (None if start == 1 else 1)
    assert captured.boundary.bank_tenths == 5
    assert captured.boundary.origin == "my_team_capture"
    assert not captured.boundary.used_chips
    assert not captured.boundary.free_hit_gameweek_19
    assert {player.player_id for player in captured.boundary.players} == set(range(1, 16))
    assert all(player.purchase_price_tenths == 50 for player in captured.boundary.players)
    assert all(player.provenance.source == "my_team_stored_market" and
               player.provenance.confirmation == "assumed" for player in captured.boundary.players)
    assert all(not week.transfers for week in captured.gameweeks)
    assert planner_session.get(PlanModel, record.plan_id).foundation_state == "ready"
    assert planner_session.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(PlanGameweekPlayerModel)) == 0
    current = replace(current, bank=99.0, free_transfers=5, players=[])
    planner_session.expire_all()
    assert repository.load_canonical(record.plan_id) == captured
    assert squad.calls == 1


@pytest.mark.parametrize("legacy_transfer", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("start", [8, 18, 20])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("leading_fh", [False, True])
@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_legacy_initialization_is_once_only_and_preserves_original_rows(
    planner_session,
    planner_plan,
    planner_metadata,
    legacy_transfer,
    start,
    leading_fh,
):
    from api.models.entities import PlanModel
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanPlayerSave, PlanRepository
    from api.repositories.squad_player_lookup_repository import SquadPlayerLookupRepository
    from api.services.initialize_planner_foundations import InitializePlannerFoundationsService
    from conftest import seed_planner_players
    from sqlalchemy import select

    seed_planner_players(planner_session, planner_metadata)
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    plan_id = repository.create(
        name="Legacy",
        start_gameweek=start,
        end_gameweek=start + 2,
        initial_bank=0.7,
        initial_free_transfers=4,
    )
    for offset, week in enumerate(planner_plan.gameweeks):
        repository.save_gameweek(
            plan_id,
            start + offset,
            chip="FREE_HIT" if leading_fh and offset == 0 else None,
            bank=0.7,
            free_transfers_available=4,
            transfers_made=0,
            points_hit=0,
            players=[
                PlanPlayerSave(
                    102
                    if legacy_transfer and offset >= 1 and player.player_id == 2
                    else player.player_id,
                    role.is_starting,
                    role.bench_order,
                    role.is_captain,
                    role.is_vice_captain,
                )
                for player, role in zip(planner_plan.boundary.players, week.lineup, strict=True)
            ],
        )
    planner_session.commit()
    before = repository.get(plan_id)
    original_columns = select(
        PlanModel.name,
        PlanModel.start_gameweek,
        PlanModel.end_gameweek,
        PlanModel.initial_bank,
        PlanModel.initial_free_transfers,
        PlanModel.created_at,
        PlanModel.updated_at,
    ).where(PlanModel.id == plan_id)
    original = planner_session.execute(original_columns).one()
    service = InitializePlannerFoundationsService(
        planner_session, SquadPlayerLookupRepository(planner_session)
    )
    assert service.execute(plan_id, apply=False).status == "ready_to_initialize"
    assert service.execute(plan_id, apply=True).status == "initialized"
    after = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
    assert after.boundary.free_transfers == 4
    assert after.boundary.bank_tenths == 7
    assert after.boundary.origin == "legacy_first_gameweek_assumed"
    assert not after.boundary.used_chips
    assert len(after.gameweeks[1].transfers) == int(legacy_transfer)
    assert repository.get(plan_id) == before
    assert planner_session.execute(original_columns).one() == original
    planner_session.commit()
    assert service.execute(plan_id, apply=True).status == "already_ready"
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id) == after

def test_initialized_legacy_can_repair_one_independent_blocker_and_reopen(
    planner_session,
    planner_plan,
    planner_metadata,
):

    from api.services.plans import PlanMutationService

        name="Legacy repair",
        start_gameweek=8,
        end_gameweek=10,
        initial_bank=1.0,
        initial_free_transfers=1,
    )
    for offset, week in enumerate(planner_plan.gameweeks):
        repository.save_gameweek(
            plan_id,
            week.gameweek_number,
            chip="FREE_HIT" if offset == 0 else None,

                    player.player_id,
                    role.is_starting,

                    role.is_vice_captain,
                )
                for player, role in zip(planner_plan.boundary.players, week.lineup, strict=True)
            ],
        )

        )

@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_guarded_core_handlers_and_explicit_dependency_repair(guarded_mutations, planner_session):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from fpl_engine.rules import RuleViolationError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    initial = PlanRepository(planner_session).load_canonical(plan_id)
    owned = next(player for player in initial.boundary.players if player.player_id == 2)
    upstream = service.mutate(
        plan_id,
        mutation_body(
            intents=[
                {
                    "kind": "add_transfer",
                    "gameweek_number": 8,
                    "outgoing_player_id": 2,
                    "outgoing_ownership_id": str(owned.ownership_id),
                    "incoming_player_id": 102,
                }
            ]
        ),
    ).plan
    first = upstream.gameweeks[0].transfers[0]
    downstream = (
        service.mutate(
            plan_id,
            mutation_body(
                2,
                1,
                [
                    {
                        "kind": "add_transfer",
                        "gameweek_number": 9,
                        "outgoing_player_id": 102,
                        "outgoing_ownership_id": str(first.incoming_ownership_id),
                        "incoming_player_id": 2,
                    }
                ],
            ),
        )
        .plan.gameweeks[1]
        .transfers[0]
    )
    edit = {
        "kind": "edit_transfer",
        "decision_id": str(first.decision_id),
        "incoming_player_id": 103,
    }
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError, match="Gameweek 9"):
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(3, 2, [edit]))
    repaired = service.mutate(
        plan_id,
        mutation_body(
            4,
            2,
            [
                edit,
                {
                    "kind": "remove_transfer",
                    "decision_id": str(downstream.decision_id),
                },
            ],
        ),
    ).plan
    assert repaired.revision == 3
    assert not repaired.gameweeks[1].transfers
    frozen = repaired.gameweeks[0].transfers
    operations = [
        {"kind": "activate_chip", "gameweek_number": 8, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "move_chip", "source_gameweek": 8, "target_gameweek": 9, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "remove_chip", "gameweek_number": 9, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "change_captain", "gameweek_number": 8, "player_id": 4},
        {"kind": "change_horizon", "start_gameweek": 9, "end_gameweek": 11},
    ]
    for number, operation in enumerate(operations, start=5):
        result = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(number, number - 2, [operation]))
    assert result.plan.revision == 8
    assert result.plan.start_gameweek == 9
    assert any(player.player_id == 103 for player in result.plan.boundary.players)
    assert frozen[0].observation_source in next(
        player.provenance.source
        for player in result.plan.boundary.players
        if player.player_id == 103
    )
    assert PlanRepository(planner_session).load_canonical(plan_id) == result.plan

@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("stage", ["before_acceptance", "partial_write", "uncertain_commit"])
def test_guarded_sql_fault_boundaries(guarded_mutations, planner_session, monkeypatch, stage):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from api.services.plans import PlannerMutationError
    from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    original_save = PlanRepository.save_canonical
    original_commit = planner_session.commit
    commits = 0

    def fail_acceptance(*args, **kwargs):
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected before acceptance")

    def fail_partial_write(repository, *args, **kwargs):
        original_save(repository, *args, **kwargs)
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected after canonical flush")

    def uncertain_commit():
        nonlocal commits
        original_commit()
        commits += 1
        if commits == 2:
            raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected lost COMMIT acknowledgement")

    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "accept_mutation", fail_acceptance)
    elif stage == "partial_write":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "save_canonical", fail_partial_write)
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr(planner_session, "commit", uncertain_commit)
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as failed:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    expected = {
        "before_acceptance": "not_accepted",
        "partial_write": "accepted_not_saved",
        "uncertain_commit": "outcome_unknown",
    }[stage]
    assert failed.value.code == expected
    monkeypatch.undo()
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id).revision == int(stage == "uncertain_commit")
    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        assert repository.get_receipt(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id) is None
    else:
        lookup = service.lookup(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id)
        assert lookup.status == (
            "already_committed" if stage == "uncertain_commit" else "accepted_not_saved"
        )
        assert service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body()).committed_revision == 1
