class FakePlanRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._plans: dict[int, _StoredPlan] = {}
        self._canonical: dict[int, planning.Plan] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    def list_plans(self) -> list[PlanSummaryRecord]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def get_for_view(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        from dataclasses import replace

        record = self.get(plan_id)
        return replace(record, canonical_plan=self._canonical.get(plan_id)) if record else None

    def save_canonical(self, plan_id, plan, evaluation):
        self._canonical[plan_id] = plan
        for week, assessed in zip(plan.gameweeks, evaluation.gameweeks, strict=True):
            assert not week.transfers
            assert assessed.closing_bank_tenths is not None
            self.save_gameweek(
                plan_id, week.gameweek_number, chip=None,
                bank=assessed.closing_bank_tenths / 10,
                free_transfers_available=assessed.free_transfers_available or 0,
                transfers_made=0, points_hit=0,
                players=[PlanPlayerSave(
                    player.player_id, role.is_starting, role.bench_order,
                    role.is_captain, role.is_vice_captain,
                ) for player, role in zip(plan.boundary.players, week.lineup, strict=True)],
            )

    def get(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        plan = self._plans.get(plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return None
        return PlanRecord(
            plan_id=plan_id,
            name=plan.name,
            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=plan.initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=plan.initial_free_transfers,
            gameweeks=[
                PlanGameweekRecord(
                    gameweek_number=number,
                    chip=stored.chip,
                    bank=stored.bank,
                    free_transfers_available=stored.free_transfers_available,
                    transfers_made=stored.transfers_made,
                    points_hit=stored.points_hit,
                    players=[
                        PlanPlayerRecord(
                            player_id=player.player_id,
                            web_name=f"P{player.player_id}",
                            first_name="First",
                            second_name="Second",
                            team_id=player.player_id,
                            team_name=f"Team {player.player_id}",
                            team_short_name="TMX",
                            position=POSITIONS[player.player_id],
                            current_price=PRICES[player.player_id],
                            status="a",
                            is_starting=player.is_starting,
                            bench_order=player.bench_order,
                            is_captain=player.is_captain,
                            is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                        )
                        for player in stored.players
                    ],
                )
                for number, stored in sorted(plan.gameweeks.items())
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._plans[plan_id] = _StoredPlan(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        return plan_id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        del self._plans[plan_id]

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        plan.gameweeks = {
            number: stored for number, stored in plan.gameweeks.items() if start <= number <= end
        }

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        self._plans[plan_id].gameweeks[gameweek_number] = _StoredGameweek(
            chip=chip,
            bank=bank,
            free_transfers_available=free_transfers_available,
            transfers_made=transfers_made,
            points_hit=points_hit,
            players=list(players),
        )

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        for entry in entries:
            stored = plan.gameweeks[entry.gameweek_number]
            stored.bank = entry.bank
            stored.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            stored.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            stored.points_hit = entry.points_hit

        assert [gameweek.gameweek_number for gameweek in plan.gameweeks] == [1, 2, 3, 4]

        service = CreatePlanService(repository, FakeCurrentSquadRepository())

        service = CreatePlanService(repository, FakeCurrentSquadRepository())
        with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError) as error:
            service.execute(CreatePlanRequest(name="Plan", start_gameweek=6, end_gameweek=3))

class TestSavePlanGameweek:
    def test_bench_and_starters_can_be_reshuffled_for_free(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        squad = build_squad()
        swapped = [
            player
            if player.player_id not in (14, 15)
            else PlanPlayerSelection(
                player_id=player.player_id,
                is_starting=player.player_id == 15,
                bench_order=4 if player.player_id == 14 else None,
                is_captain=player.is_captain,
                is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
            )
            for player in squad
        ]

        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, swapped)

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 0
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 0

    def test_transfer_consumes_a_free_transfer_and_carries_forward(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=17))

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 1
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 0
        assert all(
            17 in {player.player_id for player in gameweek.players}
            for gameweek in plan.gameweeks[1:]
        )

    def test_extra_transfers_in_one_gameweek_cost_four_points(
        self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int
    ) -> None:
        squad = transfer(
            transfer(transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=17), out_id=11, in_id=16),
            out_id=10,
            in_id=20,
        )

        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, squad)

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].transfers_made == 3
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 8

    def test_wildcard_removes_the_hit(self, repository: FakePlanRepository, plan_id: int) -> None:
        squad = transfer(
            transfer(transfer(build_squad(), out_id=12, in_id=17), out_id=11, in_id=16),
            out_id=10,
            in_id=20,
        )

        plan = _save(repository, plan_id, 2, squad, chip="WILDCARD")

        assert plan.gameweeks[1].points_hit == 0
        assert plan.gameweeks[1].chip == "WILDCARD"

@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("stage", ["before_acceptance", "partial_write", "uncertain_commit"])
def test_guarded_sql_fault_boundaries(guarded_mutations, planner_session, monkeypatch, stage):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from api.services.plans import PlannerMutationError
    from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    original_save = PlanRepository.save_canonical
    original_commit = planner_session.commit
    commits = 0

    def fail_acceptance(*args, **kwargs):
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected before acceptance")

    def fail_partial_write(repository, *args, **kwargs):
        original_save(repository, *args, **kwargs)
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected after canonical flush")

    def uncertain_commit():
        nonlocal commits
        original_commit()
        commits += 1
        if commits == 2:
            raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected lost COMMIT acknowledgement")

    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "accept_mutation", fail_acceptance)
    elif stage == "partial_write":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "save_canonical", fail_partial_write)
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr(planner_session, "commit", uncertain_commit)
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as failed:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    expected = {
        "before_acceptance": "not_accepted",
        "partial_write": "accepted_not_saved",
        "uncertain_commit": "outcome_unknown",
    }[stage]
    assert failed.value.code == expected
    monkeypatch.undo()
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id).revision == int(stage == "uncertain_commit")
    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        assert repository.get_receipt(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id) is None
    else:
        lookup = service.lookup(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id)
        assert lookup.status == (
            "already_committed" if stage == "uncertain_commit" else "accepted_not_saved"
        )
        assert service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body()).committed_revision == 1

def test_repeated_horizons_rebase_chip_period_and_fh19_without_inventing_history(
    guarded_mutations, planner_session,
):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    operations = [
        {"kind": "change_horizon", "start_gameweek": 18, "end_gameweek": 21},
        {"kind": "activate_chip", "gameweek_number": 18, "chip": "WILDCARD"},
        {"kind": "activate_chip", "gameweek_number": 19, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "change_horizon", "start_gameweek": 20, "end_gameweek": 21},
        {"kind": "set_starting_transfers", "value": 0},
        {"kind": "change_horizon", "start_gameweek": 19, "end_gameweek": 21,
         "used_chips": [], "free_hit_gameweek_19": False},
        {"kind": "change_horizon", "start_gameweek": 25, "end_gameweek": 26},
        {"kind": "set_starting_chips", "used_chips": ["WILDCARD"], "free_hit_gameweek_19": False},
    ]
    for revision, operation in enumerate(operations):
        result = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(200 + revision, revision, [operation])).plan
        if revision == 3:
            assert result.boundary.free_hit_gameweek_19
            assert not result.boundary.used_chips
            assert result.boundary.free_transfers == 5
        if revision == 5:
            assert result.boundary.origin == "earlier_horizon_assumed"
            assert result.boundary.free_transfers == 0
            assert result.gameweeks[0].chip is None
            assert not result.gameweeks[0].transfers
    planner_session.expire_all()
    assert PlanRepository(planner_session).load_canonical(plan_id) == result
    assert result.boundary.bank_tenths == 10
    assert not result.boundary.free_hit_gameweek_19
    assert result.boundary.used_chips == frozenset({"WILDCARD"})

class FakePlanRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._plans: dict[int, _StoredPlan] = {}
        self._canonical: dict[int, planning.Plan] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    def list_plans(self) -> list[PlanSummaryRecord]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def get_for_view(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        from dataclasses import replace

        record = self.get(plan_id)
        return replace(record, canonical_plan=self._canonical.get(plan_id)) if record else None

    def save_canonical(self, plan_id, plan, evaluation):
        self._canonical[plan_id] = plan
        for week, assessed in zip(plan.gameweeks, evaluation.gameweeks, strict=True):
            assert not week.transfers
            assert assessed.closing_bank_tenths is not None
            self.save_gameweek(
                plan_id, week.gameweek_number, chip=None,
                bank=assessed.closing_bank_tenths / 10,
                free_transfers_available=assessed.free_transfers_available or 0,
                transfers_made=0, points_hit=0,
                players=[PlanPlayerSave(
                    player.player_id, role.is_starting, role.bench_order,
                    role.is_captain, role.is_vice_captain,
                ) for player, role in zip(plan.boundary.players, week.lineup, strict=True)],
            )

    def get(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        plan = self._plans.get(plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return None
        return PlanRecord(
            plan_id=plan_id,
            name=plan.name,
            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=plan.initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=plan.initial_free_transfers,
            gameweeks=[
                PlanGameweekRecord(
                    gameweek_number=number,
                    chip=stored.chip,
                    bank=stored.bank,
                    free_transfers_available=stored.free_transfers_available,
                    transfers_made=stored.transfers_made,
                    points_hit=stored.points_hit,
                    players=[
                        PlanPlayerRecord(
                            player_id=player.player_id,
                            web_name=f"P{player.player_id}",
                            first_name="First",
                            second_name="Second",
                            team_id=player.player_id,
                            team_name=f"Team {player.player_id}",
                            team_short_name="TMX",
                            position=POSITIONS[player.player_id],
                            current_price=PRICES[player.player_id],
                            status="a",
                            is_starting=player.is_starting,
                            bench_order=player.bench_order,
                            is_captain=player.is_captain,
                            is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                        )
                        for player in stored.players
                    ],
                )
                for number, stored in sorted(plan.gameweeks.items())
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._plans[plan_id] = _StoredPlan(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        return plan_id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        del self._plans[plan_id]

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        plan.gameweeks = {
            number: stored for number, stored in plan.gameweeks.items() if start <= number <= end
        }

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        self._plans[plan_id].gameweeks[gameweek_number] = _StoredGameweek(
            chip=chip,
            bank=bank,
            free_transfers_available=free_transfers_available,
            transfers_made=transfers_made,
            points_hit=points_hit,
            players=list(players),
        )

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        for entry in entries:
            stored = plan.gameweeks[entry.gameweek_number]
            stored.bank = entry.bank
            stored.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            stored.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            stored.points_hit = entry.points_hit

    from api.models.entities import PlanGameweekPlayerModel, PlanModel
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from conftest import seed_planner_players
    from fpl_engine.domain import PlayerPosition
    from fpl_engine.planning.models import PlayerRuleData
    from sqlalchemy import func, select

    current = FakeCurrentSquadRepository().get_current()
    current = replace(current, free_transfers=4, players=[
        replace(player, team_id=player.player_id) for player in current.players
    ])
    seed_planner_players(planner_session, {
        player.player_id: PlayerRuleData(player.player_id, PlayerPosition(player.position),
                                       player.team_id) for player in current.players
    })

    class MutableSquad:
        calls = 0

        def get_current(self):
            self.calls += 1
            return current

    squad = MutableSquad()
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    record = CreatePlanService(repository, squad).execute(
        CreatePlanRequest("Independent", start, start + 1)
    )
    planner_session.commit()
    assert record.canonical_plan is not None
    captured = repository.load_canonical(record.plan_id)
    assert captured.boundary.free_transfers == (None if start == 1 else 1)
    assert captured.boundary.bank_tenths == 5
    assert captured.boundary.origin == "my_team_capture"
    assert not captured.boundary.used_chips
    assert not captured.boundary.free_hit_gameweek_19
    assert {player.player_id for player in captured.boundary.players} == set(range(1, 16))
    assert all(player.purchase_price_tenths == 50 for player in captured.boundary.players)
    assert all(player.provenance.source == "my_team_stored_market" and
               player.provenance.confirmation == "assumed" for player in captured.boundary.players)
    assert all(not week.transfers for week in captured.gameweeks)
    assert planner_session.get(PlanModel, record.plan_id).foundation_state == "ready"
    assert planner_session.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(PlanGameweekPlayerModel)) == 0
    current = replace(current, bank=99.0, free_transfers=5, players=[])
    planner_session.expire_all()
    assert repository.load_canonical(record.plan_id) == captured
    assert squad.calls == 1

def test_legacy_initialization_is_once_only_and_preserves_original_rows(
    planner_session,
    planner_plan,
    planner_metadata,
    legacy_transfer,
    start,
    leading_fh,
):
    from api.models.entities import PlanModel
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanPlayerSave, PlanRepository
    from api.repositories.squad_player_lookup_repository import SquadPlayerLookupRepository
    from api.services.initialize_planner_foundations import InitializePlannerFoundationsService

        name="Legacy",
        start_gameweek=start,
        end_gameweek=start + 2,
        initial_bank=0.7,
        initial_free_transfers=4,
    )
    for offset, week in enumerate(planner_plan.gameweeks):
        repository.save_gameweek(
            plan_id,
            start + offset,
            chip="FREE_HIT" if leading_fh and offset == 0 else None,
            bank=0.7,
            free_transfers_available=4,
            transfers_made=0,
            points_hit=0,
            players=[
                PlanPlayerSave(
                    102
                    if legacy_transfer and offset >= 1 and player.player_id == 2
                    else player.player_id,
                    role.is_starting,
                    role.bench_order,
                    role.is_captain,
                    role.is_vice_captain,
                )
                for player, role in zip(planner_plan.boundary.players, week.lineup, strict=True)
            ],
        )
    planner_session.commit()
    before = repository.get(plan_id)
    original_columns = select(
        PlanModel.name,
        PlanModel.start_gameweek,
        PlanModel.end_gameweek,
        PlanModel.initial_bank,
        PlanModel.initial_free_transfers,
        PlanModel.created_at,

    assert repository.get(plan_id) == before
    assert planner_session.execute(original_columns).one() == original
    planner_session.commit()
    assert service.execute(plan_id, apply=True).status == "already_ready"
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id) == after

def test_guarded_core_handlers_and_explicit_dependency_repair(guarded_mutations, planner_session):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from fpl_engine.rules import RuleViolationError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    initial = PlanRepository(planner_session).load_canonical(plan_id)
    owned = next(player for player in initial.boundary.players if player.player_id == 2)
    upstream = service.mutate(
        plan_id,
        mutation_body(
            intents=[
                {
                    "kind": "add_transfer",
                    "gameweek_number": 8,
                    "outgoing_player_id": 2,
                    "outgoing_ownership_id": str(owned.ownership_id),
                    "incoming_player_id": 102,
                }
            ]
        ),
    ).plan
    first = upstream.gameweeks[0].transfers[0]
    downstream = (
        service.mutate(
            plan_id,
            mutation_body(
                2,
                1,
                [
                    {
                        "kind": "add_transfer",
                        "gameweek_number": 9,
                        "outgoing_player_id": 102,
                        "outgoing_ownership_id": str(first.incoming_ownership_id),
                        "incoming_player_id": 2,
                    }
                ],
            ),
        )
        .plan.gameweeks[1]
        .transfers[0]
    )
    edit = {
        "kind": "edit_transfer",
        "decision_id": str(first.decision_id),
        "incoming_player_id": 103,
    }
    with pytest.raises(RuleViolationError, match="Gameweek 9"):
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(3, 2, [edit]))
    repaired = service.mutate(
        plan_id,
        mutation_body(
            4,
            2,
            [
                edit,
                {
                    "kind": "remove_transfer",
                    "decision_id": str(downstream.decision_id),
                },
            ],
        ),
    ).plan
    assert repaired.revision == 3
    assert not repaired.gameweeks[1].transfers
    frozen = repaired.gameweeks[0].transfers
    operations = [
        {"kind": "activate_chip", "gameweek_number": 8, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "move_chip", "source_gameweek": 8, "target_gameweek": 9, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "remove_chip", "gameweek_number": 9, "chip": "FREE_HIT"},
        {"kind": "change_captain", "gameweek_number": 8, "player_id": 4},
        {"kind": "change_horizon", "start_gameweek": 9, "end_gameweek": 11},
    ]
    for number, operation in enumerate(operations, start=5):
        result = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(number, number - 2, [operation]))
    assert result.plan.revision == 8
    assert result.plan.start_gameweek == 9
    assert any(player.player_id == 103 for player in result.plan.boundary.players)
    assert frozen[0].observation_source in next(
        player.provenance.source
        for player in result.plan.boundary.players
        if player.player_id == 103
    )
    assert PlanRepository(planner_session).load_canonical(plan_id) == result.plan

@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
@pytest.mark.parametrize("stage", ["before_acceptance", "partial_write", "uncertain_commit"])
def test_guarded_sql_fault_boundaries(guarded_mutations, planner_session, monkeypatch, stage):
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from api.services.plans import PlannerMutationError
    from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    original_save = PlanRepository.save_canonical
    original_commit = planner_session.commit
    commits = 0

    def fail_acceptance(*args, **kwargs):
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected before acceptance")

    def fail_partial_write(repository, *args, **kwargs):
        original_save(repository, *args, **kwargs)
        raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected after canonical flush")

    def uncertain_commit():
        nonlocal commits
        original_commit()
        commits += 1
        if commits == 2:
            raise SQLAlchemyError("Injected lost COMMIT acknowledgement")

    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "accept_mutation", fail_acceptance)
    elif stage == "partial_write":
        monkeypatch.setattr(PlanRepository, "save_canonical", fail_partial_write)
    else:
        monkeypatch.setattr(planner_session, "commit", uncertain_commit)
    with pytest.raises(PlannerMutationError) as failed:
        service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body())
    expected = {
        "before_acceptance": "not_accepted",
        "partial_write": "accepted_not_saved",
        "uncertain_commit": "outcome_unknown",
    }[stage]
    assert failed.value.code == expected
    monkeypatch.undo()
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id).revision == int(stage == "uncertain_commit")
    if stage == "before_acceptance":
        assert repository.get_receipt(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id) is None
    else:
        lookup = service.lookup(plan_id, mutation_body().mutation_id)
        assert lookup.status == (
            "already_committed" if stage == "uncertain_commit" else "accepted_not_saved"
        )
        assert service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body()).committed_revision == 1

@pytest.mark.skipif(__import__("os").getenv("RUN_DB_TESTS") != "1", reason="Requires guarded SQL")
def test_rebased_boundary_remains_editable_through_repeated_horizon_changes(
    guarded_mutations, planner_session,
):
    from api.models.entities import PlanTransferDecisionModel, PlayerModel
    from api.repositories.plan_repository import PlanRepository
    from sqlalchemy import select, update

    service, plan_id = guarded_mutations
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    initial = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
    owned = next(player for player in initial.boundary.players if player.player_id == 2)
    planner_session.execute(update(PlayerModel).where(PlayerModel.id == 2).values(current_price=5.4))
    planner_session.commit()
    revision = 0

    def mutate(intent):
        nonlocal revision
        result = service.mutate(plan_id, mutation_body(100 + revision, revision, [intent]))
        revision = result.plan.revision
        return result.plan

    bought = mutate({"kind": "add_transfer", "gameweek_number": 8, "outgoing_player_id": 2,
                     "outgoing_ownership_id": str(owned.ownership_id), "incoming_player_id": 102})
    prefix_decision = bought.gameweeks[0].transfers[0]
    sold = mutate({"kind": "add_transfer", "gameweek_number": 9, "outgoing_player_id": 102,
                   "outgoing_ownership_id": str(prefix_decision.incoming_ownership_id), "incoming_player_id": 2})
    retained = sold.gameweeks[1]
    rebased = mutate({"kind": "change_horizon", "start_gameweek": 9, "end_gameweek": 10})
    carried = next(player for player in rebased.boundary.players if player.player_id == 102)
    assert carried.slot_id == owned.slot_id
    assert carried.ownership_id == prefix_decision.incoming_ownership_id
    assert carried.provenance.basis_kind == "planned_acquisition"
    assert carried.provenance.confirmation is None
    assert rebased.boundary.bank_tenths == 12
    assert owned.ownership_id in rebased.boundary.bank_assumptions
    assert rebased.gameweeks[0] == retained
    corrected = mutate({"kind": "correct_purchase_price", "ownership_id": str(carried.ownership_id),
                        "price_tenths": 48})

@dataclass
class _StoredGameweek:
    chip: str | None
    bank: float
    free_transfers_available: int
    transfers_made: int
    points_hit: int
    players: list[PlanPlayerSave]


@dataclass
class _StoredPlan:
    name: str
    start_gameweek: int
    end_gameweek: int
    initial_bank: float
    initial_free_transfers: int
    gameweeks: dict[int, _StoredGameweek] = field(default_factory=dict)


class FakePlanRepository:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._plans: dict[int, _StoredPlan] = {}
        self._canonical: dict[int, planning.Plan] = {}
        self._next_id = 1

    def list_plans(self) -> list[PlanSummaryRecord]:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def get_for_view(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        from dataclasses import replace

        record = self.get(plan_id)
        return replace(record, canonical_plan=self._canonical.get(plan_id)) if record else None

    def save_canonical(self, plan_id, plan, evaluation):
        self._canonical[plan_id] = plan
        for week, assessed in zip(plan.gameweeks, evaluation.gameweeks, strict=True):
            assert not week.transfers
            assert assessed.closing_bank_tenths is not None
            self.save_gameweek(
                plan_id, week.gameweek_number, chip=None,
                bank=assessed.closing_bank_tenths / 10,
                free_transfers_available=assessed.free_transfers_available or 0,
                transfers_made=0, points_hit=0,
                players=[PlanPlayerSave(
                    player.player_id, role.is_starting, role.bench_order,
                    role.is_captain, role.is_vice_captain,
                ) for player, role in zip(plan.boundary.players, week.lineup, strict=True)],
            )

    def get(self, plan_id: int) -> PlanRecord | None:
        plan = self._plans.get(plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return None
        return PlanRecord(
            plan_id=plan_id,
            name=plan.name,
            start_gameweek=plan.start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=plan.end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=plan.initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=plan.initial_free_transfers,
            gameweeks=[
                PlanGameweekRecord(
                    gameweek_number=number,
                    chip=stored.chip,
                    bank=stored.bank,
                    free_transfers_available=stored.free_transfers_available,
                    transfers_made=stored.transfers_made,
                    points_hit=stored.points_hit,
                    players=[
                        PlanPlayerRecord(
                            player_id=player.player_id,
                            web_name=f"P{player.player_id}",
                            first_name="First",
                            second_name="Second",
                            team_id=player.player_id,
                            team_name=f"Team {player.player_id}",
                            team_short_name="TMX",
                            position=POSITIONS[player.player_id],
                            current_price=PRICES[player.player_id],
                            status="a",
                            is_starting=player.is_starting,
                            bench_order=player.bench_order,
                            is_captain=player.is_captain,
                            is_vice_captain=player.is_vice_captain,
                        )
                        for player in stored.players
                    ],
                )
                for number, stored in sorted(plan.gameweeks.items())
            ],
        )

    def create(
        self,
        *,
        name: str,
        start_gameweek: int,
        end_gameweek: int,
        initial_bank: float,
        initial_free_transfers: int,
    ) -> int:
        plan_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        self._plans[plan_id] = _StoredPlan(
            name=name,
            start_gameweek=start_gameweek,
            end_gameweek=end_gameweek,
            initial_bank=initial_bank,
            initial_free_transfers=initial_free_transfers,
        )
        return plan_id

    def update_details(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        *,
        name: str | None = None,
        start_gameweek: int | None = None,
        end_gameweek: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        if name is not None:
            plan.name = name
        if start_gameweek is not None:
            plan.start_gameweek = start_gameweek
        if end_gameweek is not None:
            plan.end_gameweek = end_gameweek

    def delete(self, plan_id: int) -> None:
        del self._plans[plan_id]

    def delete_gameweeks_outside(self, plan_id: int, *, start: int, end: int) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        plan.gameweeks = {
            number: stored for number, stored in plan.gameweeks.items() if start <= number <= end
        }

    def save_gameweek(
        self,
        plan_id: int,
        gameweek_number: int,
        *,
        chip: str | None,
        bank: float,
        free_transfers_available: int,
        transfers_made: int,
        points_hit: int,
        players: list[PlanPlayerSave],
    ) -> None:
        self._plans[plan_id].gameweeks[gameweek_number] = _StoredGameweek(
            chip=chip,
            bank=bank,
            free_transfers_available=free_transfers_available,
            transfers_made=transfers_made,
            points_hit=points_hit,
            players=list(players),
        )

    def update_accounting(self, plan_id: int, entries: list[PlanGameweekAccounting]) -> None:
        plan = self._plans[plan_id]
        for entry in entries:
            stored = plan.gameweeks[entry.gameweek_number]
            stored.bank = entry.bank
            stored.free_transfers_available = entry.free_transfers_available
            stored.transfers_made = entry.transfers_made
            stored.points_hit = entry.points_hit

description: "Dependency-ordered implementation tasks for Planner Foundations"

**Authority**: FR-001 through FR-049, SC-001 through SC-009, R-01 through R-12 and resolved Q-1 through Q-7. The approved first-saved-GW legacy boundary and permanent-prefix rebase decisions remain fixed. This document schedules implementation; it does not change the specification or claim any implementation is complete.

**Tests**: Required by the specification's reference scenarios, accepted plan and constitution. Write the relevant tests first, observe the expected failure, implement the owning behavior, then run the smallest relevant checks before advancing. Reuse existing builders/modules. Proposed filenames below are implementation targets, not files claimed to exist already.

**Organization**: Shared prerequisites precede six user-story phases in specification priority order. Shared replay and transport are deliberately foundational because every story must use one authority and one guarded writer. Story tasks add their integration, presentation and acceptance proof rather than implementing competing engines.
- Task format: `- [ ] Tnnn [P?] [USn?] Description with exact path`.
- `[P]` marks disjoint files that may be worked on concurrently only after their stated prerequisites. It is not permission to skip phase gates or run destructive SQL fixtures together.
- Use mise-pinned tools, local uv/pnpm dependencies and existing libraries. No new service, runtime dependency, application scaffold or general workflow/state framework is required.
- API captures observations and persists; `fpl_engine` owns rules/replay; web submits field/domain intent. No live price fetch, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy or projection dependency in the engine.

- DB tests must use `TEST_DATABASE_URL`, a database name ending `_test`, and `ensure_test_database_url`; never fall back to development data. Migration fixtures must be isolated from other SQL suites.
- No Explorer navigation/redesign/pricing changes, My Team financial changes, xPts changes, history/versioning, speculative prices, same-GW round trips, optimisation or broad visual redesign.

- Every phase is an internal reviewable increment. Do not switch persistent application writers until additive schema, explicit operator initialization and the matching web/API release are ready. No half-migrated legacy write adapter is allowed.
**Purpose**: Confirm the existing toolchain and verification entrypoints, without re-scaffolding the monorepo or mutating persistent data.

Do not execute this future command during planning. Explicit operator approval/backup is required before using `--apply` against persistent data. Integration fixtures must still use `TEST_DATABASE_URL`/the existing safeguard before initialization or schema setup.

Use deterministic synthetic player metadata and independent hand-calculated expectations, not the same evaluator as the oracle. Unless a scenario specifies otherwise, select a legal 15-player multi-club squad and legal XI/bench/C/VC.
| Starting FT 0..5, default and GW1 | New post-GW1 plan defaults to 1 even when My Team differs. Zero means no transfers remain. GW1 is unlimited/N/A, no pre-used chips; GW2 has exactly 1. |
| First-GW ordinary transfer | Against independent boundary: one meaningful replacement with starting FT0 yields count1/hit4, then next FT1. WC/FH yields no hit; BB/TC do not waive the hit. |
| Ordinary chain | Start GW8 FT2; make 1,0,4 transfers in GWs8,9,10: available 2,2,3; GW10 hit4; GW11 FT1. Total hits are correct. |
| WC/FH rollover | Parameterize available N=0..5 and arbitrary transfer counts: next FT=`min(5,max(N-1,0)+1)`, no hit. WC/FH must never use old `N+1` rule. |
| BB/TC ordinary | N3 and moves0/1/4 -> next FT4/3/1, hits0/0/4. GW1 still feeds exactly FT1. No 2025/26 top-up. |

| Chip periods/declarations | Four chip types, once per period, one per GW. Used before and planned elsewhere have distinct reasons. Contradictions reject in both directions with conflicting GW. First-period unused chips lapse. |

| Boundary restrictions | WC/FH GW1 reject, BB/TC GW1 accept. FH19 plus FH20 rejects in either order; previous-GW19 declaration rejects FH20. Other same-type chips19/20 accept. GW20 has no used second-period declarations. |
| Sales | Purchase50 with market48/50/51/52/53/54 -> sale48/50/50/51/51/52. Check integer output and bank, not rounded float coincidence. |
| Save then refresh | Create decision, change stored latest market, GET/reload/lineup save: old assumptions/acquisition/sale/bank unchanged. Explicit edit captures latest only for that decision. |

| Provenance correction | Purchase50, saved market54, sale52; correct purchase48 while live market56 -> sale51. Incoming acquisition and saved market54 unchanged; bank decreases1. Confirmation-only changes no money and clears only relevant provisional dependency. |

| Accepted shortfall | Correct basis, preserve decisions/assumptions, derive earliest negative bank/amount/chain on replay and reopen. Later positive bank alone does not erase an earlier negative node. No persisted resolution markers. |

| Earliest failure moves | Before GW9=-1/GW10=-3; repair to GW9=0/GW10=-2. Accept because every shortfall improves; derive GW10 as earliest. Compare per-GW deficits, not issue IDs. Unrelated legal edits retain unchanged old deficits; new/worse shortfall rejects outside Q7. |

| Upstream acquisition edit | New acquisition basis changes dependent later sale using that sale's saved market, never its incoming price. If the explicit edit creates insolvency, reject atomically under Q2 rather than Q7. |

| WC permanence/FH reversion | Start/last FH; FH before/after WC; retained WC player keeps basis; acquired WC player gains permanent basis. FH restores permanent squad/bank/provenance, including corrected/assumed basis and genuine latest-market display. |

| FH deficit branch | Correction affects temporary FH sales and later permanent sales using each saved assumption. Temporary deficit stays a plan issue; it does not contaminate restored permanent bank. Permanent-origin issues remain dependent through FH. |
| Sell and buy back | Across different GWs: new acquisition basis/ownership identity and correct count. Same-GW round trips are not a transaction-history feature. |

| Explicit progression / Example A | GW8 ordinary A->B and no GW9 decision yields B in GW9. Enable FH8: restore A in GW9, zero GW9 transfers; no inferred A->B. Disable FH: B permanent again, quotes unchanged. Materialized old GW9 membership must not affect replay. |

| Missing outgoing / Example B | GW8 A->B, GW10 B->C. Propose A->D in GW8: GW10 reports `outgoing_not_owned`, never becomes D->C automatically. Q2 rejects this new blocked candidate alone. Explicit atomic batch removes or user-replaces GW10 decision; validate all and save once. Test removal/edit of earlier acquisition and outgoing ownership mismatch too. |

| Horizon changes | Start-later rebase carries permanent bank/ownership/FT and chip declarations, handles FH19->new start20. Extension after last FH uses permanent state. No unresolved prefix issue erased. Earlier start preserves retained decisions, validates new-period declarations and fabricates no historical data. |

Original captured source/value and boundary bank remain intact; dependent sales use saved market assumptions under Q7. Add/edit a retained-GW transfer using current prices under Q2; reopen with the new boundary and edits preserved, independent of My Team. |

API service/router tests cover one typed mutation path, retired-writer responses and a single engine source for replay/accounting. Add real PostgreSQL tests for:

- Slot/decision/receipt uniqueness and plan ownership, exactly 15 boundary/lineup slots, and coherent revision/child reads. Inject failure during canonical input/selling-price/receipt writes and prove complete canonical rollback.

- One POST automatically evaluates and saves; no public prepare/commit routes. Fail before durable receipt: pending/unaccepted proposal. Fail after valid pending receipt: accepted-not-saved candidate/quotes survive. Retry same ID after live refresh resumes captured inputs; no extra committed revision.

- Commit succeeds before response/enrichment loss: same ID returns `already_committed`, not a repeat write. Simulate an uncertain database COMMIT outcome and require `outcome_unknown`/same-ID reconciliation, not an assumed rollback. Advance aggregate revision and retry again: return original committed revision plus current plan, not the old candidate.

- Pending receipt becomes stale after revision/rule-context change: `stale_reprepare_required`; no historical base/candidate reconstruction or silent re-quote. A new ID with an old expected revision returns `revision_conflict` without acceptance/capture/write. Same ID/different digest rejects. Exercise concurrent duplicate receipt creation, a duplicate reaching the final lock after the first request commits (returns `already_committed`), and 404 lookup while an original request is still running.

Review completed work independently of how the implementation describes
itself. A green CI run is not sufficient for approval.
- conformity with the accepted spec/acceptance criteria;
- correctness, including edge cases the implementation narrative doesn't
- architectural boundary violations (e.g. domain code depending on FastAPI,
external API calls outside infrastructure adapters, FPL rules
re-implemented in the UI instead of the domain layer);
- failure/error handling, especially silently swallowed errors;
- unsafe persistence/database behaviour (missing migrations, bypassing the
`_test` database safeguard, destructive operations against non-test data);
- missing tests at the layer that owns the changed behaviour;
- insufficient browser verification for UI changes (see
- scope creep beyond the stated task;
- unnecessary complexity relative to the size of the change.
Prioritise concrete defects and risks over style preferences. Call out
anything that was asserted to work but not actually verified.

# Planner Foundations Validation Guide

This guide retains the full feature's validation scenarios below. The first approved increment, T001-T037 (shared foundations and US1 Starting State), is implemented and verified as recorded here. US2 and later stories are not implemented or certified by this increment. See [plan.md](plan.md), [data-model.md](data-model.md) and [contracts/planner-api.md](contracts/planner-api.md); [spec.md](spec.md) remains the acceptance authority.

## Prerequisites And Safety

Use repository-root commands with the mise-pinned toolchain, project-local `.venv`/pnpm workspace dependencies and the existing environment setup in `README.md`. Current versions: Node 22.7.0, Python 3.12.15, uv 0.5.24, pnpm 9.9.0. Existing installed dependencies are sufficient; no new service is planned.

For DB-touching tests, `TEST_DATABASE_URL` must point to the dedicated database whose name ends `_test` (normally `fpl_test`). The existing `ensure_test_database_url` safeguard must run before destructive setup. Never substitute `DATABASE_URL`/development data, weaken the safeguard, or run an Alembic downgrade on the development database. If the test DB is unavailable, use the repository's explicit skip/fail path and report it. Migration round-trip fixtures require an isolated test database/schema and must not collide with concurrently running integration tests.

## Focused Automated Checks

### Increment 1 Preflight (2026-10-14)

Implementation scope is T001-T037 only (shared foundations and US1). Both
requirements-quality checklists passed before implementation (16/16 and 35/35).
`mise current` confirmed Node 22.7.0, Python 3.12.15, uv 0.5.24 and pnpm 9.9.0.
Run Alembic head inspection from `apps/api`; using `-c apps/api/alembic.ini`
from the repository root does not resolve the relative script directory:

```sh
cd apps/api && mise exec -- uv run --package api alembic heads
```

From the repository root, after the corresponding slice/tests exist:

```sh
mise exec -- uv run --package fpl-engine pytest -q packages/fpl_engine/tests/test_rules.py packages/fpl_engine/tests/test_planning.py
mise exec -- env PYTHONPATH=packages/fpl_engine/src uv run --package api pytest -q apps/api/tests/plans
mise exec -- pnpm --filter web test:run tests/plans/plan-board.test.tsx tests/team/my-team-board.test.tsx
```

`test_planning.py` contains the focused replay tests. Ordinary API runs skip DB-gated cases; do not mistake fake-boundary or skipped results for SQL proof.

With Docker running and the dedicated test URL confirmed:

```sh
mise exec -- make db-test-up
mise exec -- make test-integration
```

`make test-integration` uses `RUN_DB_TESTS=1` and `TEST_DATABASE_URL` through repository tooling. New Planner repository/atomicity/migration cases must join that guarded suite. Upgrade/backfill/downgrade/re-upgrade fixtures must create controlled legacy rows, compare them after rollback and remove only their isolated test resources. Do not replace `make test-integration` with a destructive ad-hoc script on the normal API connection.

## Initialization And Rollout Verification

The implemented `api.scripts.initialize_planner_foundations` entrypoint provides `--check` (read-only readiness/diagnostic report) and `--apply` (once-only per-plan transactional initialization). Tests call its service against guarded isolated fixtures; do not run the operator apply procedure on development data merely to test it.

Operational sequence after implementation: take a normal database backup, apply additive schema, run `--check`, explicitly run `--apply`, review its report, then switch the web/API writers together. Pending plans remain explicitly unavailable for editing with retryable diagnostics; there is no legacy write fallback. GET must not initialize them. Before any new application edits, isolated downgrade tests prove old rows untouched without per-plan rollback payloads. After new-only writes, rollback requires explicit backup/export plus conversion/restore; a downgrade must refuse a falsely lossless in-place conversion.

Read-only readiness command, after an operator applies the additive schema:

```sh
cd apps/api && PYTHONPATH=src:../../packages/fpl_engine/src mise exec -- uv run --package api python -m api.scripts.initialize_planner_foundations --check
```

Initialization readiness does not certify legacy legality: independent diagnostics remain visible and repairable.

## Expected Domain Scenarios

Use deterministic synthetic player metadata and independent hand-calculated expectations, not the same evaluator as the oracle. Unless a scenario specifies otherwise, select a legal 15-player multi-club squad and legal XI/bench/C/VC.

| Scenario | Expected evidence |
|----------|-------------------|
| Starting FT 0..5, default and GW1 | New post-GW1 plan defaults to 1 even when My Team differs. Zero means no transfers remain. GW1 is unlimited/N/A, no pre-used chips; GW2 has exactly 1. |
| First-GW ordinary transfer | Against independent boundary: one meaningful replacement with starting FT0 yields count1/hit4, then next FT1. WC/FH yields no hit; BB/TC do not waive the hit. |
| Ordinary chain | Start GW8 FT2; make 1,0,4 transfers in GWs8,9,10: available 2,2,3; GW10 hit4; GW11 FT1. Total hits are correct. |
| WC/FH rollover | Parameterize available N=0..5 and arbitrary transfer counts: next FT=`min(5,max(N-1,0)+1)`, no hit. WC/FH must never use old `N+1` rule. |
| BB/TC ordinary | N3 and moves0/1/4 -> next FT4/3/1, hits0/0/4. GW1 still feeds exactly FT1. No 2025/26 top-up. |
| Chip periods/declarations | Four chip types, once per period, one per GW. Used before and planned elsewhere have distinct reasons. Contradictions reject in both directions with conflicting GW. First-period unused chips lapse. |
| Boundary restrictions | WC/FH GW1 reject, BB/TC GW1 accept. FH19 plus FH20 rejects in either order; previous-GW19 declaration rejects FH20. Other same-type chips19/20 accept. GW20 has no used second-period declarations. |
| Sales | Purchase50 with market48/50/51/52/53/54 -> sale48/50/50/51/51/52. Check integer output and bank, not rounded float coincidence. |
| Save then refresh | Create decision, change stored latest market, GET/reload/lineup save: old assumptions/acquisition/sale/bank unchanged. Explicit edit captures latest only for that decision. |
| Provenance correction | Purchase50, saved market54, sale52; correct purchase48 while live market56 -> sale51. Incoming acquisition and saved market54 unchanged; bank decreases1. Confirmation-only changes no money and clears only relevant provisional dependency. |
| Accepted shortfall | Correct basis, preserve decisions/assumptions, derive earliest negative bank/amount/chain on replay and reopen. Later positive bank alone does not erase an earlier negative node. No persisted resolution markers. |
| Earliest failure moves | Before GW9=-1/GW10=-3; repair to GW9=0/GW10=-2. Accept because every shortfall improves; derive GW10 as earliest. Compare per-GW deficits, not issue IDs. Unrelated legal edits retain unchanged old deficits; new/worse shortfall rejects outside Q7. |
| Upstream acquisition edit | New acquisition basis changes dependent later sale using that sale's saved market, never its incoming price. If the explicit edit creates insolvency, reject atomically under Q2 rather than Q7. |
| WC permanence/FH reversion | Start/last FH; FH before/after WC; retained WC player keeps basis; acquired WC player gains permanent basis. FH restores permanent squad/bank/provenance, including corrected/assumed basis and genuine latest-market display. |
| FH deficit branch | Correction affects temporary FH sales and later permanent sales using each saved assumption. Temporary deficit stays a plan issue; it does not contaminate restored permanent bank. Permanent-origin issues remain dependent through FH. |
| Sell and buy back | Across different GWs: new acquisition basis/ownership identity and correct count. Same-GW round trips are not a transaction-history feature. |
| Explicit progression / Example A | GW8 ordinary A->B and no GW9 decision yields B in GW9. Enable FH8: restore A in GW9, zero GW9 transfers; no inferred A->B. Disable FH: B permanent again, quotes unchanged. Materialized old GW9 membership must not affect replay. |
| Missing outgoing / Example B | GW8 A->B, GW10 B->C. Propose A->D in GW8: GW10 reports `outgoing_not_owned`, never becomes D->C automatically. Q2 rejects this new blocked candidate alone. Explicit atomic batch removes or user-replaces GW10 decision; validate all and save once. Test removal/edit of earlier acquisition and outgoing ownership mismatch too. |
| Horizon changes | Start-later rebase carries permanent bank/ownership/FT and chip declarations, handles FH19->new start20. Extension after last FH uses permanent state. No unresolved prefix issue erased. Earlier start preserves retained decisions, validates new-period declarations and fabricates no historical data. |
| Rebased plan edits | After start-later rebase, change starting FT/chip declarations and correct a new starting player's basis, including a carried planned acquisition. Original captured source/value and boundary bank remain intact; dependent sales use saved market assumptions under Q7. Add/edit a retained-GW transfer using current prices under Q2; reopen with the new boundary and edits preserved, independent of My Team. |
| Completed GW edits | Apply lineup and transfer edits to a completed GW with the same legality/persistence rules. Only the explicitly edited transfer captures current prices; unaffected decisions stay frozen. No historical lock or reconstructed historical price is introduced. |
| Per-GW lineup isolation | XI/bench/C/VC edits stay local; propagated replacement inherits only outgoing slot/role. Same legal targets and captaincy outcome on My Team/Planner. GK never reorders into outfield bench priority. Direct invalid requests reject. |

## Persistence, Migration And Concurrency Proof

API service/router tests cover one typed mutation path, retired-writer responses and a single engine source for replay/accounting. Add real PostgreSQL tests for:

- Slot/decision/receipt uniqueness and plan ownership, exactly 15 boundary/lineup slots, and coherent revision/child reads. Inject failure during canonical input/selling-price/receipt writes and prove complete canonical rollback.
- One POST automatically evaluates and saves; no public prepare/commit routes. Fail before durable receipt: pending/unaccepted proposal. Fail after valid pending receipt: accepted-not-saved candidate/quotes survive. Retry same ID after live refresh resumes captured inputs; no extra committed revision.
- Commit succeeds before response/enrichment loss: same ID returns `already_committed`, not a repeat write. Simulate an uncertain database COMMIT outcome and require `outcome_unknown`/same-ID reconciliation, not an assumed rollback. Advance aggregate revision and retry again: return original committed revision plus current plan, not the old candidate.
- Pending receipt becomes stale after revision/rule-context change: `stale_reprepare_required`; no historical base/candidate reconstruction or silent re-quote. A new ID with an old expected revision returns `revision_conflict` without acceptance/capture/write. Same ID/different digest rejects. Exercise concurrent duplicate receipt creation, a duplicate reaching the final lock after the first request commits (returns `already_committed`), and 404 lookup while an original request is still running.
- Old PUT/PATCH return 410 and cannot change either canonical or quarantined data. Stale expected revision and competing mutations cannot overwrite newer state; no automatic cross-tab merge is claimed.
- Corrected inputs survive reopen and reproduce financial flags from replay alone; no resolution/cached-status rows. Reject a batch mixing Q7 corrections with unrelated planning mutations, so a new unaffordable transfer cannot borrow the correction exception. Confirm GET is read-only and market refresh leaves saved assumptions/bank unchanged.
- Legacy plan with ordinary first GW, leading FH, period crossing, incorrect old WC/FH cache, and an old illegal chip/squad. Preserve original rows/decisions and expose estimates/repair issues. No current-My-Team substitution or external FPL call.
- Once-only snapshot-to-decision conversion and rerun/refresh idempotence; missing prices leave original rows/pending status intact. Verify isolated upgrade/backfill/downgrade/re-upgrade preserves original rows/values without rollback copies, never deletes new plans, and refuses unsafe reversal after new-only edits.
- Clear a backfilled canonical `planned_chip` while the quarantined legacy `chip` remains populated: GET/reopen must retain the cleared choice, never consult/fall back to the legacy value. Compare quarantined membership/chip/accounting values before and after initialization.

Component tests use stateful realistic fixtures and deferred promises, not static save responses. Queue captain C then vice D before the first response: dispatch the vice-only envelope at the acknowledged new revision and retain C. Assert no complete lineup payload is queued; test a removed target requiring reselection. Cover navigation, rapid edits, late responses, unaccepted failure vs accepted-not-saved, identical retry after ambiguous success, explicit stale reconciliation, retained Q7 context, rejection preserving earlier unsaved work, departure protection and no Save Gameweek control.

## Browser Setup And Journeys

Follow `.github/skills/ui-browser-verification/SKILL.md`. Do not start servers or mutate development state merely to validate this planning document. Durable Planner tests should use deterministic stateful intercepted API fixtures for error/timing/price edge cases, paired with actual API/PostgreSQL tests above for true persistence/atomicity proof. A mocked browser response alone does not prove backend saving.

Run the implemented first-increment journey file:


Protect important journeys with durable Playwright tests:

1. Create a plan/start at GW12, set FT3 and used WC; confirm period-boundary chip reasons, lightweight nonblocking price estimates and first-GW transfer accounting. Reload after acknowledgement.
2. Change captain C, delay response, choose vice D and switch GW immediately. Verify requests contain field intents/rebased revisions, C is not reset, per-GW choices remain independent and reload retains final acknowledged state. No save action.
3. Inspect a saved transfer's basis/live/saved prices and the explicit saved-price policy, simulate refresh, verify bank stability; explicitly edit and observe a new quote. Correct provenance to expose a shortfall, verify earliest issue/amount/chain and saved status, reload, repair and verify cleared flags. Include a completed-GW edit to rule out an unintended historical lock or repricing policy.
4. Exercise leading/last FH/WC and Examples A/B. A chip toggle never turns inherited output into a new transfer; a missing outgoing decision names its intended player and is repaired only by explicit remove/replacement in an atomic batch.

## Implementation Strategy

### MVP First

1. Finish Setup and Foundation, including actual isolated SQL proof and the minimal shared autosave path.
2. Deliver US1 as an internal starting-state increment; validate its independent scenario and durable reload/rebase cases before proceeding.
3. Do not present US1 alone as the completed foundations feature. The public readiness boundary includes all four P1 stories: trusted starting state, chips, accounting and prices/resolution. P2 autosave reliability and P3 rearrangement are also required for the approved feature's final acceptance.

### Incremental Delivery

1. Implement each phase as small tested changes at the owning layer; reuse foundation contracts throughout.
2. Finish P1 stories in the default dependency order, then harden cross-operation persistence in US5, then complete My Team parity in US6.
3. Use each story's independent scenario as its acceptance gate. Defer no required safety, receipt-durability or backend legality guarantee to browser-only verification.
4. Rehearse rollout on isolated fixtures; only explicitly authorized operators may initialize persistent plans after backup. Switch API/web writers together with no writable legacy fallback.
5. Execute the final gates and independent review, inspect the full diff and report actual evidence. Leave blocked/unverified tasks unchecked; neither this generated list nor an implementer's assertion is proof of completion.

@pytest.mark.parametrize("duplicate", [False, True])
def test_real_sql_competing_revisions_and_duplicate_final_lock(
    planner_session,
    planner_plan,
    planner_metadata,
    monkeypatch,
    duplicate,
):
    from uuid import UUID

    from api.repositories.squad_player_lookup_repository import SquadPlayerLookupRepository
    from api.schemas.plans import PlanMutationRequestBody
    from api.services.plans import PlanMutationService, PlannerMutationError
    from conftest import seed_planner_players
    from fpl_engine.planning.evaluate import evaluate_plan
    from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

    seed_planner_players(planner_session, planner_metadata)
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    plan_id = repository.create(
        name=planner_plan.name,
        start_gameweek=8,
        end_gameweek=10,
        initial_bank=1.0,
        initial_free_transfers=1,
    )
    repository.save_canonical(plan_id, planner_plan, evaluate_plan(planner_plan, planner_metadata))
    planner_session.commit()
    engine = planner_session.get_bind()
    rendezvous = Barrier(2, timeout=10)
    original = PlanMutationService._commit
    commits: dict[int, int] = {}

    def synchronized_acceptance(service):
        original(service)
        identity = id(service)
        commits[identity] = commits.get(identity, 0) + 1
        if commits[identity] == 1:
            rendezvous.wait()

    monkeypatch.setattr(PlanMutationService, "_commit", synchronized_acceptance)

    def worker(number):
        with Session(engine) as session:
            service = PlanMutationService(session, SquadPlayerLookupRepository(session))
            body = PlanMutationRequestBody.model_validate(
                {
                    "mutation_id": str(UUID(int=1 if duplicate else number)),
                    "expected_revision": 0,
                    "intents": [{"kind": "rename_plan", "name": "Concurrent"}],
                }
            )
            try:
                return service.mutate(plan_id, body).status
            except PlannerMutationError as error:
                return error.code

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
        outcomes = sorted(executor.map(worker, [1, 2]))
    assert outcomes == (
        ["already_committed", "committed"]
        if duplicate
        else ["committed", "stale_reprepare_required"]
    )
    assert repository.load_canonical(plan_id).revision == 1

def test_coherent_reader_blocks_canonical_child_revision_change(
    planner_session,
    planner_plan,
    planner_metadata,
):
    from threading import Event

    from api.repositories.squad_player_lookup_repository import SquadPlayerLookupRepository
    from api.schemas.plans import PlanMutationRequestBody
    from api.services.plans import PlanMutationService
    from sqlalchemy import event

    seed_players(planner_session, planner_metadata)
    repository = PlanRepository(planner_session)
    row = new_plan(planner_session)
    plan_id = row.id
    repository.save_canonical(plan_id, planner_plan, evaluate_plan(planner_plan, planner_metadata))
    planner_session.commit()
    snapshot = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
    engine = planner_session.get_bind()
    attempting_lock = Event()

    def on_statement(connection, cursor, statement, parameters, context, executemany):
        if "FOR UPDATE" in statement:
            attempting_lock.set()

    def writer():
        with Session(engine) as session:
            request = PlanMutationRequestBody.model_validate(
                {
                    "mutation_id": str(UUID(int=9000)),
                    "expected_revision": 0,
                    "intents": [
                        {
                            "kind": "correct_purchase_price",
                            "ownership_id": str(snapshot.boundary.players[0].ownership_id),
                            "price_tenths": 49,
                        }
                    ],
                }
            )
            return PlanMutationService(session, SquadPlayerLookupRepository(session)).mutate(
                plan_id, request
            )

    event.listen(engine, "before_cursor_execute", on_statement)
    try:
        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor:
            future = executor.submit(writer)
            try:
                assert attempting_lock.wait(10)
                assert not future.done()
                coherent = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
                assert coherent.revision == 0
                assert coherent.boundary.players[0].purchase_price_tenths == 50
            finally:
                planner_session.rollback()
            assert future.result(timeout=10).committed_revision == 1
        reopened = repository.load_canonical(plan_id)
        assert reopened.revision == 1
        assert reopened.boundary.players[0].purchase_price_tenths == 49
    finally:
        event.remove(engine, "before_cursor_execute", on_statement)
